First World Army.name: Ejército del Primer Mundo
First World Army.description: Este army is composed of an eclectic mix of fey, beasts, and plants—a supernatural mob of monsters with a wide range of options in battle.

campaignFeature->Battlefield Adaptabilit.name: Battlefield Adaptability
campaignFeature->Battlefield Adaptabilit.description: The ejército del Primer Mundo has a wide range of criaturas in sus ranks, and puede shift sus tactics to support those with different mobilities. It puede realizar está acción to achieve one of the following benefits: Ignore ground-based terreno difícil, reduce @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.oVhkdym3D6TiTbrN]{Mired} to 0, quedar @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.tWS8aMCyeGKcnFh1]{Oculto}, or gain a +2 bonificador por circunstancia on prueba de Maniobras to Advance and to Disengage. The effect lasts hasta el comienzo del siguiente turnoo de Ejército del Primer Mundo.

campaignFeature->Battlefield Adaptabilit.name: Battlefield Adaptability
campaignFeature->Battlefield Adaptabilit.description: El army obtiene el unique Battlefield Adaptability war action.

campaignFeature->Primal Magic.name: Primal Magic
campaignFeature->Primal Magic.description:
Requisito ejército del Primer Mundo is not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.2IqM1XHELKwARAx1]{Engaged};

Efecto ejército del Primer Mundo uses sus primal magic against another army on the battlefield and debe intentar una prueba de Moral contra la CD de Moral. Si tiene éxito, the ejército del Primer Mundo applies one of the following effects, determined randomly ([[/r 1d10]]), to el ejército objetivo.

1–2 Entangling Vines Coils of whipping vines grow out of the ground to entangle el ejército. El ejército increases sus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.oVhkdym3D6TiTbrN]{Mired} condition by 1 (2 on a impacto crítico).

3–4 Horrific Visions Los soldados' minds are assaulted with horrific illusions. El ejército increases sus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.7LMDwpVijK7x5Jst]{Shaken} condition by 1 (2 on a impacto crítico).

5–6 Primal Storm A churning storm cloud above el ejército strikes the soldiers dozens of times with bolts of lightning, inflicting 1 point of daño a el ejército (2 puntos de daño on a impacto crítico). Until el final de the ejército objetivo's siguiente turnoo, it functions as if in high wind and rain (see Battlefield Terrain Features on page 578).

7–8 Sensory Assault Los soldados become overwhelmed with strange lights or tricked by illusions. Until el final de su siguiente turnoo, el ejército takes a –2 penalizador por circunstancia a all attacks and prueba de Maniobras.

9–10 Overwhelming Magic Roll twice and apply both results, but the ejército del Primer Mundo suffers a –4 penalizador por circunstancia a sus prueba de Moral contra el ejército objetivo's CD de Moral.

campaignFeature->Primal Magic.name: Primal Magic

campaignFeature->Supernatural Attacks.name: Supernatural Attacks
campaignFeature->Supernatural Attacks.description: Siempre que a ejército del Primer Mundo scores a impacto crítico on another army, it increases that army's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.dmzpRlOrorEFUETl]{Weary} condition by 1 as their attacks cause some soldiers to become poisoned, fall asleep, shrink in size, or suffer other eerie side effects.

campaignFeature->Tactical Training.name: Tactical Training

The Ejército del Primer Mundo puede usar the following tactical actions: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8wjiF3ctXUjP9oyX]{Contraataque}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.G2eBcOnUHb3yT7JL]{Lucha sucia}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.Hi4LKGOKe6yMDOH5]{Fintar}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ggVahjiAlVICpiPA]{Provocar}.

Flooding Room.name: Flooding Room
Flooding Room.description: When the western secret door is opened or any of the trapdoors in the ceiling are forced open, the trap is triggered. As soon as this occurs, the portcullises to the east and west come crashing down, each consisting of solid iron sheets that form watertight seals. At the same time, the dozen 5-pies-wide trapdoors open in the ceiling. Estos holes are the mouths of winding tunnels that connect to a second pair of apertures on the submerged side of the island outside, allowing the waters of the Little Sellen River to plunge down into this room, possibly damaging or knocking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado} those in the square portion of the room itself (but not in the adjoining hallway) and eventualiado flooding the entire chamber.
Flooding Room.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:26] (este increases a @Check[thievery|dc:30] once el trampa es activated) a disable one de el 12 trapdoors y seal ello shut; disabling todos 12 de el trapdoors completely deactivates el trampa, but un fallo critico en cualquier attempt causes el trampa a trigger; @Check[thievery|dc:24] a disable one de el watertight portcullises y prevent ello de falling; magia such as shape piedra o muro de piedra o even lock puede also be used a disable portions de este deadly trampa at el DJ's discretion
Flooding Room.reset: La trampa must be reset with a major engineering effort.
Flooding Room.routine:
(12 actions) La trampa loses 1 action for each of sus 12 trampillas del techo that are disabled. On each of the trap's actions, it pours water into the room, filling it to a depth of one inch. If all 12 trapdoors are open, it thus fills the room at a rate of 1 pies per asalto. If one of the portcullises is breached, the trap fills the room at half the rate, and if both are breached, it fills at one quarter the rate. Once the cascada de agua begins, su easy enough for a PC to avoid the downpour, but any criatura that deliberately enters the cascade is subjected to the trap's Rushing Water reaction. If una criatura is struck by Rushing Water while already underwater, the result of sus Reflex salvación is automáticamente improved one degree of éxito.

The flooding ends and the trap deactivates once the área is filled to the ceiling-at this point, the water's surface is at the level of the river, and at the top of the stairs leading down from areas D4 and D6. A Mediano or smaller criatura can try to Swim to freedom through one of the 5-pies-wide tunnels leading to the river from a trapdoor, but doing so requires navigating 200 pies of flooded tunnels.

action->Rushing Water.name: Rushing Water
action->Rushing Water.description:
Desencadenante se abre la puerta secreta al oeste o cualquier trampilla.

Efecto 12 trampillas del techo open along with the two secret doors to the cyclops zombie alcoves, releasing river water and zombies into the room. Cualquier criatura situada in the central 40-by-40 pies section of the main room debe intentar una @Check[reflex|dc:28] salvación; the la trampa tira iniciativa.

Éxito crítico La criatura no sufre daño.

Éxito La criatura takes @Damage[(1d10+6)[bludgeoning]] daño de the cascada de agua.

Fallo La criatura takes @Damage[(2d10+13)[bludgeoning]] daño de the cascada de agua.

Fallo crítico La criatura takes @Damage[(2d10+13)[bludgeoning]] daño de the cascade of agua que cae and queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

Foras.name: Foras
Foras.publicNotes:
El man who would reciben el name Foras grew up millennia ago among worshipers de Pharasma, yet el came a believe que el Outer Gods fueron el keys a claiming personal power. He tricked su people's priests into a imparting eldritch truths ellos would no normalmente share, then shared them con un few fellow secretive scholars de el oculto.

Gathering those whom Foras could manipulate, el retreated a un nuevo stronghold-un location now known as Candlemere. Here, Foras's cult gave up su sight y su souls, solo a quedan trapped con him dentro de su own compound cuando su leader's brother tracked them down y imprisoned them. Yet even este hasn't stymied Foras, y el continues a este dia a work toward su goal de drawing Yog-Sothoth into el world.

action->Unseen Sight.name: Unseen Sight
action->Unseen Sight.description: The ritual Foras led his cultists on allowed them to turno aside time and halt aging, but it required more than the sacrifice of an individual's given name-it required the sacrifice of sight itself. The removal of the eyes symbolized a Thresholder's abandonment of all they had seen before, and with the ritual's completion they gain something greater than mere vision: they gain the Unseen Sight. Este is a precise sense that mimics @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.qCCLZhnp2HhP3Ex6]{Darkvision} yet functions even if the eye sockets themselves are covered. More importantly, the unseen sight allows a Thresholder to see the truth of the world, granting them the ability to see things as they actualiado are as if they were under el efectos of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight}, provided they are located within a region under the influence of Yog- Sothoth. Currently in the Stolen Lands, this is limited to the island of Candlemere and the dungeons within it; beyond this área, the Thresholder cultists quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blind}. Of course, if their plan to draw Yog-Sothoth into the region succeeds, the region in which the unseen sight functions will increase dramaticaliado.

action->Outside of Time.name: Outside of Time
action->Outside of Time.description: Foras exists outside of time; he no age, no need food or drink to survive, and no puede ser @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado} unless elige to be.

Worshipers of Yog-Sothoth are immune to Time Siphon.

Freshly Bloomed Basilisk.publicNotes: El basilisco es un reptil de ocho patas con un carácter desagradable y la capacidad de convertir criaturas en piedra con la mirada. El folclore sostiene que, al igual que ocurre con la cocatriz, los primeros basiliscos nacieron de huevos coriáceos puestos por serpientes.

Gedovius.name: Gedovius
Gedovius.publicNotes:
Gargoyles are monstrous hunters made of elemental stone. They use their resemblance to decorative statues to hide in plain sight in cities during the día and descend upon unlucky pedestrians at night. Their most common form is that of a horned humanoid with bat-like wings, but individual gargoyles show a great deal of variation, with some appearing more or less humanoid and others resembling no known criatura. A gargoyle's features are not flxed; city-dwelling gargoyles who remain in the same locale long enough slowly morph, día by día, to match the style of the local architecture. Estos patient monsters can stay disguised for long stretches of time as they patiently await an opportunity to strike.

Gargoyles tend to be lone hunters, though sometimes they band into fearsome tribes called "wings" for protection or sport. On rare occasions, wings become relatively stable communities, and gargoyles in wings may even aliado with other criaturas such as demons and intelligent aberrations, though these alliances exist on a razor's edge. The majority of gargoyles are treacherous, vindictive, and petty-rasgos that preclude lasting partnerships. Many tend to be obsessive and compulsive. Some are collectors, focusing on anything from books to grim trophies, while others are ritualistic or overly passionate about niche intellectual subjects or certain artistic motifs. Estos tendencies often contribute to the dissolution of wings as individuals' obsessions and compulsions clash.

action->Clawed Feet.name: Clawed Feet

Grabbles.name: Grabbles
Grabbles.publicNotes:
Mitflits, also known as mites, are self-loathing and pitiful cowards, easily bullied into servitude by other criaturas or even slightly more powerful mitflit leaders. They tame insects, spiders, and other such criaturas to serve as faithful aliados. Mitflits have lost most of their ancestral gremlin magic, leaving these incomplete beings full of doubt and insecurity. Mitflits find companionship in the other base criaturas of the world, and forge bonds of friendship with vermin, the only other beings that seem willing to accept them. A social structure, even one in which they are bullied, partialiado fills the hole within mitflits' personalities, and they rarely rebel or rail out unless their rage hits a breaking point.

Gremlins are cruel fey tricksters and saboteurs who have fully acclimated to life on the Material Plane, finding distinct niches for their inventive destructiveness. All gremlins delight in ruining or breaking things, whether su something physical like a device or vehicle or something intangible such as an alliance or relationship. A gremlin's greatest joy is watching the collapse of complex creations, preferably after the lightest and slightest, carefully objetivoed push from the gremlin. Gremlins tend to denigrate, bully, or even slaughter their lesser kin, particularly mitflits, whom gremlins (and many others) derisively call "mites."

Grigori.name: Grigori
Grigori.publicNotes:
El bard Grigori es un charismatic orator y un agent de Pitax who seeks a undermine el PJ' authority mientras spying en su kingdom. He shows up en el kingdom's capital city mientras el PJ son out adventuring y immediately begins giving speeches criticizing y denigrating su leadership y actions. More y more de el townsfolk gather a hear him talk y, as el dias wear en, el builds un wellspring de support among el disaffected settlers en el town. Every decision el PJ make tiene un winner y un loser, y Grigori es gifted at shifting focus a el losers en these decisions y riling them up. Whether ello es appealing a el citizens who didn't get what ellos wanted cuando el PJ built un nuevo city block, a spinning un narrative que paints un recent event en el most horrid light for those for whom el outcome fue un negative, un properly played Grigori should quedan un constant barb en el players' side y one de el most memorable villains ellos encounter. Grigori recibe great pains a avoid breaking cualquier de el PJ' laws so que ellos tienen no legal justification a arrest him otro than que ellos want a silence him.

Grigori es more than just un itinerant storyteller; el's un spy y agent provocateur sent by King Irovetti, el Lord de Pitax, a spread chaos y dissent en el town con el aim de overthrowing el PJ y possibly paving el way for Pitax a annex el settlement. In order a cobertura su rastros y retain plausible deniability, Irovetti used several layers de agents a hire Grigori; as far as el bard knows, el fue hired a cause trouble en este fledgling town by agents de Fort Drelev a el west.

Hannis Drelev.name: Hannis Drelev
Hannis Drelev.publicNotes:
Hannis Drelev spent his youth in Brevoy frustrated at the lack of opportunity for advancement. When he heard Lady Jamandi was looking for volunteers to aid her in exploring and taming the Stolen Lands, he saw an opportunity to bolster his fame. In the months since, Hannis has come to regret his decision, and now that tiene been forced to surrender to Irovetti and Armag, his attitude has shifted from frustration to outright cruelty.

Drelev comes across as a sullen, greedy, conceited man, never satisfied with his lot in life, but always disdainful of anyone who has less than him. Though skilled at politics, the baron fancies himself a skilled swordsman as well. He loves dueling and often spars against his own guardsmen and senior officers. He likes to show off, taunting and belittling those he overpowers, but reacts angrily to situations where others get the best of him.

A patient opponent who prides himself on his ability to skillfully outmaneuver his enemigos, Baron Drelev begins nearly every turno with Defensive Slice. He favors disarming enemigos, and attempts to do so una vez por asalto when facing an armed enemigo, mocking them wickedly if he's successful and cursing them violently if not.

Hargulka.name: Hargulka
Hargulka.publicNotes:
Before his dreams were invaded and his ambitions enhanced by Nyrissa's eldritch manipulations, Hargulka had already established himself as a leader among trollkind, though his goals never reached beyond bullying his fellow trolls into rampaging the immediate environs for food and wealth to bring back to him as offerings. The notion of becoming a "king" never crossed his mind until he had a vivid, unforgettable dream of himself sitting atop a throne and basking in the fear and adoration of not only trolls, but hobgoblins, harpies, and all manner of slavering monsters-criaturas who might be viewed as dangerous enemigos but, to Hargulka, were now his loyal minions.

To Hargulka, the PCs' kingdom is rightfully his own. He intends to conquer them, claim their capital for himself, and dine on the flesh and bones of their citizens. Yet despite these violent goals, the troll knows better than to simply attack his enemigos mindlessly. Instead, he spends his time working with his loyal trolls to seek out like-minded monsters in the wilds to recruit them to his cause. As a result, the longer Hargulka remains in power, the more dangerous and aggressive the monsters of the Stolen Lands will become!

Egoístas y toscos, estos asaltantes de piel áspera son matones y, en última instancia, cobardes. De mal genio y amante de la violencia, un gigante de las colinas ataca y saquea con gusto a los indefensos, pero huye rápidamente de aquellos que son más grandes, más fuertes o mejor organizados que ellos. Un gigante de las colinas nunca deja de empujar o engañar a uno de su especie para ralentizar a su oponente o conseguir el mejor botín.

Los gigantes son enormes criaturas humanoides que viven en lugares remotos.regiones de todo el mundo. Se dividen en varios subtipos.

Found mostly en colder climates, mammoths son accustomed a dealing con desperate y dangerous predators, trampling y crushing su enemigos mientras using su larger tusks a mayor effect. humanoides dwelling en harsh, frost-bound lands rely en el mammoth's strength a help them survive.

Immediately recognizable by su long, prehensile trunks y impressive tusks, elephants tienen diferente characteristics depending en where ellos son found. Elephants son used as beasts de burden en many regions, but ellos son extremely clever y debe be handled con great care.

Hooktongue Hydra.name: Hidra Lenguagarfio
Hooktongue Hydra.publicNotes: La hidra tiene regeneración igual a 3 veces el número de cabezas que posee. Si al cuerpo de una hidra le falta alguna cabeza y los muñones restantes no han sido cauterizados, la hidra intenta una salvación después de recuperar Puntos de Golpe por regeneración. Con un éxito, una cabeza vuelve a crecer; con un éxito crítico, vuelven a crecer dos.

action->Hydra Regeneration.name: Hydra Regeneración
action->Hydra Regeneration.description:
The hydra has regeneration equal to 3 x the number of heads tiene. If a hydra's body is missing any heads and the remaining stumps have not been cauterized, the hydra intenta una @Check[fortitude|immutable:true|dc:35] salvación after it regains Puntos de Golpe from regeneration. Con un éxito, one uncauterized stump regrows two heads; con un éxito crítico, two uncauterized stumps regrow into two heads each. The hydra can never grow more than double the number of heads it ordinarily has. The hydra's regeneration only fully deactivates if all sus heads are severed and all stumps are cauterized, at which point it dies.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Regeneración]

Nota: The source specifies hydra regeneration 15, but this conflicts with standard hydra regeneration.

action->Head Regrowth.name: Head Regrowth
action->Head Regrowth.description:
A hydra ordinarily has five heads. Una criatura can attempt to sever one of the hydra's heads by specificaliado objetivoing it and dealing daño equal to the head's Puntos de Golpe. A head que está not completely severed returns to full Puntos de Golpe at el final de any criatura's turno.

A hydra can regrow a severed head using Hydra Regeneración. Una criatura can prevent this regrowth by dealing acid or daño de fuego to the stump, cauterizing it. Single-objetivo acid or fire effects need to be objetivoed at a specific stump, but effects that deal daño de salpicadura or affect areas covering the hydra's whole space cauterize all stumps if they deal acid or daño de fuego. Si el attack that severs a head deals any acid or daño de fuego, the stump is cauterized instantly. If all five heads are cauterized, the hydra dies.

Hydra Head

  • Puntos de Golpe 45
  • Immunities Area Damage
  • Weaknesses Slashing 5

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.uZJOdounIHaFDC1t]{Efecto: Hydra Heads}

action->Multiple Opportunities.name: Multiple Opportunities
action->Multiple Opportunities.description: Una hidra obtiene una reacción adicional por asalto por cada cabeza que tenga más allá de la primera, que solo puede usar para realizar Ataques de Oportunidad. No puede usar más de 1 reacción ante la misma acción desencadenante, incluso si una criatura abandona varias casillas dentro de su alcance, y la hidra debe usar una cabeza distinta para cada Ataque de Oportunidad que realice. Siempre que una de las cabezas de la hidra sea cercenada, la hidra pierde 1 de sus reacciones adicionales por asalto.

action->Focused Assault.name: Focused Assault
action->Focused Assault.description: La hidra ataca a un único objetivo con sus cabezas, abrumando a su enemigo con múltiples ataques y dejándole muy poco espacio para esquivar. La hidra realiza Golpes con sus colmillos. Con un ataque éxitoso, la hidra inflige al objetivo el daño de su Golpe de colmillos, más [[/r 1d6]] de daño adicional por cada cabeza que tenga más allá de la primera. Incluso con un ataque fallido, la hidra inflige a la criatura objetivo el daño de un Golpe de colmillos, aunque falla por completo con un fallo crítico. Esto cuenta para el penalizador por ataques múltiples de la hidra como un número de ataques igual al número de cabezas que tenga.

action->Storm of Jaws.name: Storm of Jaws
action->Storm of Jaws.description: La hidra realiza un número de Golpes de hasta su número de cabezas, cada uno contra un objetivo diferente. Estos ataques cuentan para el penalizador por ataques múltiples de la hidra, pero el penalizador por ataques múltiples no aumenta hasta después de que la hidra haya realizado todos sus ataques.

Ilthuliak.name: Ilthuliak
Ilthuliak.publicNotes:
Murderous tyrants of marshes, swamps, bogs, and fens, black dragons terrorize their domains with intense fervor. Gleefully sadistic, they rule their fetid principalities from a deep cave or otherwise isolated part of the swamp with a mix of lightning-quick raids and subterfuge. Their hatred for other criaturas is as acidic as their breath armas, and they rarely tolerate even other dragons of their kind-except perhaps to mate or temporarily collaborate to take down a mutual enemigo.

Black dragons are amphibious-although they breathe air, their gills also allow them to breathe water. Their frills and fins make them accomplished swimmers, well suited to their wetland environments and submerged lairs. They're immune to the fetid water that comes as a result of their magical ability to corrupt water.

Black dragon lairs are as foul as their souls. The floors are littered with rotting meat, and plundered treasures line the muck and slime of their dank caves amid twisted roots and creepers. Such places are often crawling with pests, snakes, and slimes. Though they claim natural caverns when pueden, they make do with areas of dense, twisted vegetation within a swamp. Black dragon treasure hoards primarily consist of gems and expensive glass work, as valuables of softer substance no puede survive the dragon's acidic presence.

While there are many types of dragons, from the powerful planar dragons to the strange esoteric dragons, few dragon varieties are as well-known and as rightly feared as the chromatic dragons. Differentiated by the hue of their scales, each color of dragon unleashes sus own flavor of murderous cruelty-be it by claw, tooth, or breath-and unlike most criaturas, dragons only become more powerful as they age. Their lust for treasure, food, bloodshed, and control are legendario. Physicaliado powerful with egos to match, these dragons are often moreunido depraved and act as criminal masterminds, vicious tyrants, or voracious raiders.

Immense Mandragora.name: Immense Mandragora
Immense Mandragora.publicNotes:
A mandragora looks like a freshly pulled tuber que tiene grown into the malformed shape of a child with a grotesque face and hideously bloated body. Estos insidious little plants normalmente form when a mandrake root is watered with a demon's blood. Upon absorbing the otherworldly properties of the demon's blood, the root animates and is forced to seek out blood to feast from, lest it die of thirst.

Always famished and in search for sustenance, mandragoras live haunted, pained lives and perform vile and desperate acts to acquire the blood they crave. While they prefer magicaliado infused blood such as that of unicorns, fey, or sorcerers, and pueden also feed off of potions, alchemical bombs, and other magical elixirs, a mandragora can subsist on the blood of non-magical criaturas. They find the flavor of mundane blood to be bland and bitter, and they do not blanch at voicing these complaints to la criaturas from which they drink.

While the typical mandragora is the size of a human child, some of these evil plants continue to grow and grow, reaching sizes more comparable to those of giants. Sometimes as they grow, they form additional limbs or rudimentary faces, eventualiado transforming into truly hideous mockeries of the human form.

action->Blood Scent.name: Blood Scent
action->Blood Scent.description: A mandragora can smell criaturas with blood as an imprecise sense at a range of 30 pies, and puede smell demons, fey, and sorcerers with blood as a precise sense at a range of 30 pies.

Irahkatu.name: Irahkatu
Irahkatu.publicNotes:
The ahuizotl is a vicious, semi-aquatic predator that resembles a hideous cross between a badger and an otter, with disturbingly web-fingered paws supplemented by a fifth hand at el final de a long, serpentine tail. A clever and stealthy hunter, the ahuizotl lures unwary prey to their doom by mimicking the cries of people in distress. The ahuizotl's macabre habit of feeding on a victim's eyes, fingernails, and teeth leaves the corpses of sus kills uniquely mutilated. Some say la criaturas consider these body parts delicacies, while others insist ahuizotls collect them as tribute to a powerful but unknown entity. The fact that an ahuizotl does not eat the actual flesh of sus victims, instead depositing their savaged and waterlogged corpses in locations where the remains are sure to be found by friends or family, points to a third and perhaps more likely possibility-the ahuizotl simply enjoys using sus violent dietary quirks to spread fear and despair.

An ahuizotl walks on all fours, but sus hands are capable of manipulating simple tools and other objects. Ahuizotls have roughly mustelid features and an extra membrane covering their eyes, giving their eyes a dull color suggestive of cataracts and somewhat blunting de la criatura vision. Yet despite their bestial appearance, ahuizotls are nearly as intelligent as the average human, and wiser than most. Although they no form societies of their own, tienen been known to aliado with violent cults or conclaves of monsters, and even to found small shrines and temples to sinister deities. The cult of Charon, the horseman of Death, is particularly popular among certain ahuizotls, who look forward to an afterlife spent wallowing in the waters of the River Styx.

Irovetti's Fetch.name: Irovetti's Fetch
Irovetti's Fetch.publicNotes:
Fetch stalkers form from the souls of Mediano or Pequeño fey or humanoids (Pequeño fetch stalkers have the same statistics as Mediano ones.)

A fetch is a twisted, deviant simulacrum of a humanoid criatura that exists or existed at one point on the Material Plane. Rumors of fetches that are reflections of entities from other planes persist, but none of these tales speak of fetches that duplicate anything other than a sapient source. A fetch can manifest spontaneously when a powerful criatura undergoes a significant emotional event or dies, either while on the First World or while in an área significantly influenced by the First World, but one can also be created by significant forces like the Eldest in order to torment and vex those who have annoyed them. While a fetch manifests from a soul's "reflection," and as such bears a striking resemblance to esa criatura's appearance in life, a fetch has no true memories of sus own. It keeps fragments of false remembrances from sus source as if it experienced them in a half-remembered dream-which ensure the fetch is enraged by and jealous of sus source.

A fetch is similar in appearance to la criatura whose soul spawned it, salvación that it often displays fey-like features such as pointed ears, plantlike elements, or supernatural grace. A fetch who seeks to impersonate a stillliving source must disguise these features, and takes care to manifest sus fetch arma as one known to be wielded by sus objetivo.

When a fetch dies, it and sus manifested items fades away into a bloom of plant life, sus soul instantly recycled into the First World, leaving behind a patch of weeds and thorny flowers roughly in the shape they held in mockery while alive.

Jamandi Aldori.name: Jamandi Aldori
Jamandi Aldori.publicNotes:
Jamandi Aldori's upbringing in Restov could have ensured her a safe and relaxed life as one of that city's nobles, but her restlessness and frustration with "meddling" from the north increasingly pushed her away from the aristocratic lifestyle. She quickly mastered the art of the Aldori sword, and over the years has become one of Restov's most well-known swordlords, in part due to her skill in dueling, but of late as a result of her increasingly obvious pushes to expand Restov's power in directions that minimize reliance upon the rest of Brevoy. Beyond organizing the push into the Stolen Lands and her desire to foster a new aliado to the south, she hopes some día to found additional dueling schools beyond Brevoy's borders where the Aldori style can be taught-a pursuit that not all of her peers equitativamente approve of.

Characters who earn Jamandi's trust and support can unlock access to the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.cBBwTnJrVmvaRMYq]{Aldori Duelist} archetype at tu option.

feat->Research Field.name: Campo De Investigacion
feat->Research Field.description:
Tu inquiries into the alchemical naturaleza of the universe have led tu to focus on a particular field of research. Tú might have a degree from a scientific institute, correspond with other researchers in tu field, or work as a genius loner. Elige a field of research.

Tu research field adds a number of formulas to tu formula book; these are tu signature items. When using a batch of infused reagents to create tu signature items using advanced alchemy, tu create three items instead of two. Each time obtienes a level, puedes swap one of tu signature items with another formula in tu formula book. Este new signature item must be on tu research field's list of possible signature items.

feat->Alchemy.name: Alquimia
feat->Alchemy.description:
Tú understand the complex interactions of natural and unnatural substances and can concoct alchemical items to meet tu needs. Puedes do this using normal reagents and the Craft activity, or puedes use special infused reagents that allow tu to craft temporary items quickly and at no cost. Over time, puedes create more and more alchemical items for free, and since each of them becomes more and more powerful, tu advance in power dramaticaliado, leaving behind those who no understand tu strange science.

Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical CRAFTING} feat, even if tu no meet that feat's prerequisites, and obtienes the four common 1st-level alchemical formulas granted by that feat. Puedes use this feat to create alchemical items as long as tienes the items' formulas in tu formula book.

feat->Formula Book.name: Libro de fórmulas
feat->Formula Book.description:
An alchemist keeps meticulous formulas for every item pueden create. Tú start with a standard @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qCEOZ6109Yo34tRx]{Formula Book (Blank)} worth 10 sp or less for free. The formula book contains the formulas for two common 1st-level alchemical items of tu choice, in addition to those tu gained from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical CRAFTING} and tu research field.

Each time obtienes a level, puedes add the formulas for two common alchemical items to tu formula book. Estos new formulas can be for any level of item puedes create. Aprendes these formulas automáticamente, but su also possible to find or buy additional formulas in settlements or from other alchemists, or to invent them with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XR95taODq1sq82Du]{Inventor} feat.

feat->Bomber.name: Bombardero
feat->Bomber.description:
Tú specialize in explosions and other violent alchemical reactions. Tú start with the formulas for two common 1st-level alchemical bombs, in addition to tu other formulas.

Tu research field adds a number of formulas to tu formula book; these are tu signature items. When using a batch of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.wySB9VHOW1v3TX1L]{infused Reagents} to create tu signature items using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Pe0zmIqyTBc2Td0I]{Advanced Alchemy}, tu create three items instead of two. Each time obtienes a level, puedes swap one of tu signature items with another formula in tu formula book. Este new signature item must be on tu research field's list of possible signature items.

When throwing an alchemical bomb with the splash rasgo, puedes deal daño de salpicadura to only tu primary objetivo instead of the usual splash área.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8QAFgy9U8PxEa7Dw]{Field Discovery}Level 5

When using Advanced Alchemy to make bombs during tu daily preparations, puedes use a batch of reagents to create any three bombs instead of just two of the same bomb.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.DFQDtT1Van4fFEHi]{Perpetual Infusions}Level 7

Tienes learned how to create perpetual alchemical infusions that puede proporcionar a near-infinite supply of certain simple items. Obtienes the ability to create two 1st-level alchemical items using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.sPtl05wwTpqFI0lL]{Quick Alchemy} without spending a batch of infused reagents. The items puedes select depend on tu research field and must be in tu formula book.

Each time obtienes a level, puedes swap any number of tu perpetual infusions with other eligible infusions.

Elige two 1st-level bombs.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8rEVg03QJ71ic3PP]{Perpetual Potency}Level 11

Tu perpetual infusions improve, allowing tu to use Quick Alchemy to create more powerful items with no cost. The items puedes select depend on tu research field and must be in tu formula book.

The moderate versions of the bombs tu chose for perpetual infusions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RGs4uR3CAvgbtBAA]{Greater Field Discovery}Level 13

Puedes increase the splash on tu bombs to daño criaturas within 10 pies, or 15 pies if tienes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.gyVcJfZTmBytLsXq]{Expanded Splash}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.xO90iBD8XNGyaCkz]{Perpetual Perfection}Level 17

Tienes perfected tu perpetual infusions, allowing tu to use Quick Alchemy to create even more powerful items at no cost. The items puedes select depend on tu research field and must be in tu formula book.

The greater versions of the bombs tu chose for perpetual infusions.

0.text: Puedes deal daño de salpicadura to only tu primary objetivo instead of the usual splash área.

feat->Infused Reagents.name: Reactivos Infundidos
feat->Infused Reagents.description:
Tú infuse reagents with tu own alchemical essence, allowing tu to create alchemical items at no cost. Each día during tu daily preparations, obtienes a number of batches of infused reagents equal to tu nivel + tu inteligencia modifier. Puedes use these reagents for either advanced alchemy or Quick Alchemy, described below. Together, these infused reagents have light Volumen.

As soon as tu make tu next daily preparations, tu infused reagents from the previous día's preparations are instantly destroyed, and nonpermanent effects of tu previous día's infused items immediately end. While infused reagents are physical objects, they no puede ser duplicated, preserved, or created in any way other than tu daily preparations. Any such artificial reagents lack the infusion and are useless for advanced alchemy or Quick Alchemy.

feat->Advanced Alchemy.name: Alquimia avanzada
feat->Advanced Alchemy.description:
During tu daily preparations, after producing new @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.wySB9VHOW1v3TX1L]{infused Reagents}, puedes spend batches of those infused reagents to create infused alchemical items.

Tú no need to intentar una prueba de CRAFTING to do this, and tu ignore both the number of días normalmente required to create the items and any alchemical reagent requirements.

Tu advanced alchemy level is equal to tu nivel. For each batch of infused reagents pasas, elige an alchemical item of tu advanced alchemy level or lower that's in tu formula book, and make a batch of two of that item.

Estos items have the infused rasgo and remain potent durante 24 horas or until tu next daily preparations, whichever comes first.

Tú swiftly mix up a short-lived alchemical item to use at a moment's notice. Creas a single alchemical consumable item of tu advanced alchemy level or lower that's in tu formula book without having to spend the normal monetary cost in alchemical reagents or needing to intentar una prueba de CRAFTING. Este item has the infused rasgo, but it remains potent only until el comienzo de tu siguiente turnoo.

backpack->Bag of Holding (Type II).description:
La etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JBMBaN9dZLytfFLQ]

Aunque parece un saco de tela decorado con paneles de seda de colores vivos o bordados elegantes, una bolsa de contencion se abre a un espacio extradimensional mayor que sus dimensiones exteriores. El Volumen guardado dentro de la bolsa no cambia el Volumen de la propia bolsa de contencion. La cantidad de Volumen que puede contener el espacio extradimensional de la bolsa depende de su tipo.

Puedes Interactuar con la bolsa de contencion para meter o sacar objetos igual que con un saco corriente. Aunque la bolsa puede contener una gran cantidad de material, un objeto aun debe caber por la abertura del saco para poder guardarse en su interior.

Si la bolsa se sobrecarga o se rompe, se rasga y queda arruinada, haciendo que los objetos de su interior se pierdan para siempre. Si se le da la vuelta, los objetos de su interior se derraman sin sufrir daños, pero la bolsa debe volver a ponerse correctamente antes de poder usarse de nuevo. Una criatura viva colocada dentro de la bolsa tiene aire suficiente para 10 minutos antes de empezar a asfixiarse, y puede intentar Escapar contra una CD 13. Un objeto dentro de la bolsa no proporciona beneficios salvo que se recupere primero. Un objeto en la bolsa no puede ser detectado por magia que solo detecte cosas en el mismo plano.

Capacidad 50 Volumen

Sample Items Alchemical Items such as Elixirs

Una pequena esfera de llamas aparece en la palma de tu mano, y la arrojas cuerpo a cuerpo o a distancia. Haz una tirada de ataque de conjuro contra la CA de tu objetivo. Normalmente es un ataque a distancia, pero tambien puedes hacer un ataque cuerpo a cuerpo contra una criatura dentro de tu alcance sin armas.

Con un éxito, infliges 2d4 de daño de fuego. Con un éxito crítico, el objetivo sufre el doble de daño y @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] de daño persistente de fuego.

Intensificado (+1) Aumenta el daño en 1d4 y el daño persistente de un impacto crítico en 1d4.

feat->Research Field.name: Campo De Investigacion
feat->Research Field.description:
Tu inquiries into the alchemical naturaleza of the universe have led tu to focus on a particular field of research. Tú might have a degree from a scientific institute, correspond with other researchers in tu field, or work as a genius loner. Elige a field of research.

Tu research field adds a number of formulas to tu formula book; these are tu signature items. When using a batch of infused reagents to create tu signature items using advanced alchemy, tu create three items instead of two. Each time obtienes a level, puedes swap one of tu signature items with another formula in tu formula book. Este new signature item must be on tu research field's list of possible signature items.

feat->Alchemy.name: Alquimia
feat->Alchemy.description:
Tú understand the complex interactions of natural and unnatural substances and can concoct alchemical items to meet tu needs. Puedes do this using normal reagents and the Craft activity, or puedes use special infused reagents that allow tu to craft temporary items quickly and at no cost. Over time, puedes create more and more alchemical items for free, and since each of them becomes more and more powerful, tu advance in power dramaticaliado, leaving behind those who no understand tu strange science.

Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical CRAFTING} feat, even if tu no meet that feat's prerequisites, and obtienes the four common 1st-level alchemical formulas granted by that feat. Puedes use this feat to create alchemical items as long as tienes the items' formulas in tu formula book.

feat->Formula Book.name: Libro de fórmulas
feat->Formula Book.description:
An alchemist keeps meticulous formulas for every item pueden create. Tú start with a standard @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qCEOZ6109Yo34tRx]{Formula Book (Blank)} worth 10 sp or less for free. The formula book contains the formulas for two common 1st-level alchemical items of tu choice, in addition to those tu gained from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.is3Oz9wt11lNq62K]{Alchemical CRAFTING} and tu research field.

Each time obtienes a level, puedes add the formulas for two common alchemical items to tu formula book. Estos new formulas can be for any level of item puedes create. Aprendes these formulas automáticamente, but su also possible to find or buy additional formulas in settlements or from other alchemists, or to invent them with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.XR95taODq1sq82Du]{Inventor} feat.

feat->Field Discovery.name: Descubrimiento de campo
feat->Field Discovery.description: Aprendes a special discovery depending on tu field.

feat->Powerful Alchemy.name: Alquimia poderosa
feat->Powerful Alchemy.description: Alchemical items tu create on the fly are particularly potent. When tu use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.sPtl05wwTpqFI0lL]{Quick Alchemy} to create an infused alchemical item that allows a tirada de salvación, puedes change sus DC to tu CLASS DC.

feat->Alchemical Weapon Expertise.name: Experiencia Con Las Armas Alquímicas
feat->Alchemical Weapon Expertise.description: Te has entrenado para blandir con mas eficacia las armas que encuentras en tu laboratorio. Tus rangos de competencia con armas sencillas, ataques sin armas y bombas alquimicas aumentan a experto.

feat->Iron Will.name: Voluntad De Hierro
feat->Iron Will.description:
alchemist Tu mental defenses are an iron fortress. Tu proficiency rank for salvación de Voluntads increases to experto.

ranger Tu training has hardened tu resolve. Tu proficiency rank for salvación de Voluntads increases to experto.

feat->Perpetual Infusions.name: Infusiones Perpetuas
feat->Perpetual Infusions.description:
Has aprendido a crear infusiones alquímicas perpetuas que pueden proporcionar un suministro casi infinito de ciertos elementos simples.

Obtienes la capacidad de crear dos elementos alquímicos de primer nivel usando @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.sPtl05wwTpqFI0lL]{Quick Alchemy} sin gastar un lote de reactivos infundidos. Los elementos que puede seleccionar dependen de su campo de investigación y deben estar en su libro de fórmulas.

Cada vez que subes de nivel, puedes intercambiar cualquier cantidad de tus infusiones perpetuascon otras infusiones elegibles.

feat->Bomber.name: Bombardero
feat->Bomber.description:
Tú specialize in explosions and other violent alchemical reactions. Tú start with the formulas for two common 1st-level alchemical bombs, in addition to tu other formulas.

Tu research field adds a number of formulas to tu formula book; these are tu signature items. When using a batch of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.wySB9VHOW1v3TX1L]{infused Reagents} to create tu signature items using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Pe0zmIqyTBc2Td0I]{Advanced Alchemy}, tu create three items instead of two. Each time obtienes a level, puedes swap one of tu signature items with another formula in tu formula book. Este new signature item must be on tu research field's list of possible signature items.

When throwing an alchemical bomb with the splash rasgo, puedes deal daño de salpicadura to only tu primary objetivo instead of the usual splash área.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8QAFgy9U8PxEa7Dw]{Field Discovery}Level 5

When using Advanced Alchemy to make bombs during tu daily preparations, puedes use a batch of reagents to create any three bombs instead of just two of the same bomb.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.DFQDtT1Van4fFEHi]{Perpetual Infusions}Level 7

Tienes learned how to create perpetual alchemical infusions that puede proporcionar a near-infinite supply of certain simple items. Obtienes the ability to create two 1st-level alchemical items using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.sPtl05wwTpqFI0lL]{Quick Alchemy} without spending a batch of infused reagents. The items puedes select depend on tu research field and must be in tu formula book.

Each time obtienes a level, puedes swap any number of tu perpetual infusions with other eligible infusions.

Elige two 1st-level bombs.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.8rEVg03QJ71ic3PP]{Perpetual Potency}Level 11

Tu perpetual infusions improve, allowing tu to use Quick Alchemy to create more powerful items with no cost. The items puedes select depend on tu research field and must be in tu formula book.

The moderate versions of the bombs tu chose for perpetual infusions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RGs4uR3CAvgbtBAA]{Greater Field Discovery}Level 13

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.xO90iBD8XNGyaCkz]{Perpetual Perfection}Level 17

Tienes perfected tu perpetual infusions, allowing tu to use Quick Alchemy to create even more powerful items at no cost. The items puedes select depend on tu research field and must be in tu formula book.

The greater versions of the bombs tu chose for perpetual infusions.

feat->Infused Reagents.name: Reactivos Infundidos
feat->Infused Reagents.description:
Tú infuse reagents with tu own alchemical essence, allowing tu to create alchemical items at no cost. Each día during tu daily preparations, obtienes a number of batches of infused reagents equal to tu nivel + tu inteligencia modifier. Puedes use these reagents for either advanced alchemy or Quick Alchemy, described below. Together, these infused reagents have light Volumen.

As soon as tu make tu next daily preparations, tu infused reagents from the previous día's preparations are instantly destroyed, and nonpermanent effects of tu previous día's infused items immediately end. While infused reagents are physical objects, they no puede ser duplicated, preserved, or created in any way other than tu daily preparations. Any such artificial reagents lack the infusion and are useless for advanced alchemy or Quick Alchemy.

feat->Advanced Alchemy.name: Alquimia avanzada
feat->Advanced Alchemy.description:
During tu daily preparations, after producing new @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.wySB9VHOW1v3TX1L]{infused Reagents}, puedes spend batches of those infused reagents to create infused alchemical items.

Tú no need to intentar una prueba de CRAFTING to do this, and tu ignore both the number of días normalmente required to create the items and any alchemical reagent requirements.

Tu advanced alchemy level is equal to tu nivel. For each batch of infused reagents pasas, elige an alchemical item of tu advanced alchemy level or lower that's in tu formula book, and make a batch of two of that item.

Estos items have the infused rasgo and remain potent durante 24 horas or until tu next daily preparations, whichever comes first.

action->Wounded Arm.name: Wounded Arm
action->Wounded Arm.description: Jurgrindor's left arm is dreadfully wounded, courtesy of Amiri's greatsword. The discomfort of this wound causes Jurgrindor to take a -2 penalizador por circunstancia to his ARMOR CLASS and Golpes (these modifications are included in his stats). He no puede usar Catch Rock or Throw Rock (as typical giants) until he's healed back to full hit points.

action->Chill Breath.description: Jurgrindor breathes out a @Template[cone|distance:15] of freezing moisture that quickly condenses into ice, dealing @Damage[2d6[cold]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic]). Una criatura que falla críticamente la salvación también está @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} hasta que Escapa (DC 18). Jurgrindor no puede usar Chill Breath for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Chill Breath]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Kargstaad.name: Kargstaad
Kargstaad.publicNotes:
Frost giants are remorseless marauders who pillage and plunder from those who dare to live near them in desolate, frigid lands. Their clans range from extremely territorial hunters who claim an expanse of tundra and defend it at all costs to nomadic hordes that roam icy slopes in search of settlements to conquer. Frost giant clans are ruled by those who exhibit the greatest ferocity and prowess in battle-massive brutes who proclaim themselves jarl and demand absolute obedience from their followers. If at any time a frost giant wishes to be a jarl, all deben do is issue a challenge to the current jarl and face off in mortal combat, after which the reigning champion continues leading the clan or the victorious challenger assumes control.

Frost giants live in frostbitten realms, and their appearance is reflective of a people weathered and hardened by relentless snowstorms and freezing temperatures. They often wear metal armadura adorned with the furs, skin, teeth, and tusks of slain beasts and heft armas as long as dining tables. Their flesh ranges from pale blue to shale gray, and their hair is normalmente a dingy white or dirty yellow color.

A typical frost giant stands about 15 pies tall and weighs approximately 2,800 pounds.

Giants are massive humanoid criaturas who live in remote regions throughout the world. They are divided into a number of subtypes.

Kargstaad's Giant.name: Kargstaad's Giant
Kargstaad's Giant.publicNotes:
Frost giants are remorseless marauders who pillage and plunder from those who dare to live near them in desolate, frigid lands. Their clans range from extremely territorial hunters who claim an expanse of tundra and defend it at all costs to nomadic hordes that roam icy slopes in search of settlements to conquer. Frost giant clans are ruled by those who exhibit the greatest ferocity and prowess in battle-massive brutes who proclaim themselves jarl and demand absolute obedience from their followers. If at any time a frost giant wishes to be a jarl, all deben do is issue a challenge to the current jarl and face off in mortal combat, after which the reigning champion continues leading the clan or the victorious challenger assumes control.

Frost giants live in frostbitten realms, and their appearance is reflective of a people weathered and hardened by relentless snowstorms and freezing temperatures. They often wear metal armadura adorned with the furs, skin, teeth, and tusks of slain beasts and heft armas as long as dining tables. Their flesh ranges from pale blue to shale gray, and their hair is normalmente a dingy white or dirty yellow color.

A typical frost giant stands about 15 pies tall and weighs approximately 2,800 pounds.

Giants are massive humanoid criaturas who live in remote regions throughout the world. They are divided into a number of subtypes.

Kob Moleg.publicNotes:

De mal genio y amante de la violencia, un gigante de las colinas ataca y saquea con gusto a los indefensos, pero huye rápidamente de aquellos que son más grandes, más fuertes o mejor organizados que ellos. Un gigante de las colinas nunca deja de empujar o engañar a uno de su especie para ralentizar a su oponente o conseguir el mejor botín.

Los gigantes son enormes criaturas humanoides que viven en lugares remotos.regiones de todo el mundo. Se dividen en varios subtipos.

La criatura está bajo the GM's control and goes on a rampage for half the night before falling unconscious until dawn.

action->Moon Frenzy.name: Frenesí lunar
action->Moon Frenzy.description: Kundal's moon frenzy functions a bit differently than for typical werecreatures: he no become Grande sized, but lo hace grow much more swift and powerful. His speed increases to 35 pies during moon frenzy and increases the daño of his jaws by +2. In addition, while in moon frenzy, at el comienzo de his turno, Kundal gains an additional reaction that can be used only to make an Attack of Opportunity.

action->Rip and Drag.name: Rip and Drag
action->Rip and Drag.description:
Requisito Kundal dañod a objetivo with his Golpe de fauces with a previous action este asalto.

Éxito Kundal inflicts @Damage[5d6[piercing]] daño on el objetivo and exposes them to the curse of the werewolf. He can reposition el objetivo up to five pies into an adjacent square.

Fallo As éxito, except only @Damage[2d6[piercing]] daño.

Fallo crítico Kundal fails to inflict any daño.

Leng Envoy.name: Leng Envoy
Leng Envoy.publicNotes:
Estos malévolos humanoides, esclavistas y asaltantes de la fría y azotada por el viento dimensión de Leng, recorren la realidad en ominosas naves negras capaces de navegar más allá las fronteras de las dimensiones y los Planos. Aunque la mayoría de los habitantes de Leng van en busca de esclavos y saqueos como cualquier pirata, otros operan como autodenominados embajadores y mercaderes, sembrando la discordia con planes a largo plazo. Aunque los inescrutables habitantes se visten con túnicas anchas, velos y grandes turbantes para parecer humanos, su aberrante fisiología, cuando se vislumbra, es evidente, desde su corona de pequeños cuernos y sus mandíbulas tentaculares hasta sus patas peludas, similares a las de una cabra.

Por encima de los feroces capitanes que comandan los infames navíos negros hay una casta aún más alta de habitantes de Leng. Estos sectarios y músicos actúan como sumos sacerdotes y se dedican a apaciguar a los temibles dioses que contemplan el Reino de las Pesadillas con fría malicia.

Lesser Jabberwock.name: Lesser Jabberwock
Lesser Jabberwock.publicNotes:
Pocas bestias han inspirado tantas leyendas, poemas, canciones y mitos en tantas culturas como está extraña criatura dracónica. El jabberwock proviene del reino de las hadas del Primer Mundo y es parte de un grupo de poderosas criaturas del Primer Mundo conocidas colectivamente como Tane.

Como todos los miembros de Tane, los jabberwocks son criaturas vivientes que envejecen, comen, beben y duermen, pero no se reproducen normalmente. En cambio, son creados directamente por los Dioses Mayores que gobiernanel Primer Mundo, y sirven al placer de estas entidades caprichosas y misteriosas. Se cree que son los más poderosos de todos los Tane, y los jabberwocks generalmente solo se crean con un propósito: causar destrucción y estragos en el plano material. Uno de los Mayores podría enviar un charlatán para devastar un país, un continente o incluso un mundo entero para vengarse de algún desaire cometido contra ellos por un solo mortal. A veces, no se requiere ningún insulto o lesión específica, ya que algunos deAl Mayor le molesta la existencia misma del Plano Material y periódicamente crea charlatanerías simplemente para expresar la ira del Primer Mundo contra su hermano menor y menos caótico.

Una vez que un jabberwock llega al plano material, su primera tarea es buscar una guarida. Prefiere habitar en lugares remotos del bosque, a un día de vuelo de la civilización; cuanto más peligroso sea el bosque para aquellos que eventualmente vengan a cazarlo, ¡mejor!

La relación entre los jabberwocks y las armas vorpales es objeto de mucho debate y especulación entre los estudiosos, y los diversos poemas, canciones y leyendas sobre los jabberwocks hacen poco para aclarar la cuestión, siendo contradictorios y divergentes en este punto. Algunos creen que las armas vorpal fueron creadas específicamente para combatir a los jabberwocks, pero otros llevan la historia un paso más allá. Citan evidencia en ciertos mitos antiguos de que alguna vez pudo haber habido solo un único,Jabberwock único, tan poderoso que nada podía siquiera rayarlo; es decir, nada, excepto la primera espada vorpal, diseñada para ese mismo propósito. La batalla resultante fue tan épica que creó extraños ecos en toda la realidad y, como resultado, estos ecos, en forma de armas vorpales, ahora se pueden encontrar en muchos mundos. Quienes suscriben está creencia afirman que los jabberwocks que se ven hoy en día no son más que pálidas imitaciones de este proto-jabberwock, y especulan que solo la combinación deLos esfuerzos de varios Mayores serían suficientes para crear tal criatura nuevamente.

Jabberwocks variantes Los mayores a veces han alterado ciertos aspectos de los jabberwocks que crean. Algunas de las variantes de jabberwocks más notorias o legendarias incluyen las siguientes.

Frumious Jabberwock: Los Frumious Jabberwocks tienen dos cabezas. Son de nivel 24 y obtienen una acción adicional en cada uno de sus turnoos que pueden usar solo para realizar un golpe de mandíbula.

Mimsy Jabberwock: Provenientes típicamente de regiones invernales del Primer Mundo, los mimsy jabberwocks tienen escamas brillantes de color blanco azulado, resisten el frío en lugar del fuego y tienen ojos que arden con llamas azules que causan daño por frío en lugar de daño por fuego.

Slithy Jabberwock: Estos sinuosos y viscosos jabberwocks, que causan destrucción bajo las olas, son anfibios, tienen una velocidad de nado de 80 pies en lugar de la velocidad normal de vuelo y no tienen un golpe de ala. un resbaladizoEl aura sibilante de Jabberwock se activa cada vez que nada, realiza un golpe con la cola o burbujea.

Criaturas quejosas y engreídas, los mephits del polvo son conocidos por su tendencia a pronunciar pesimismo en cada oportunidad, lamentando cada dificultad insignificante y menor como si fuera un obstáculo insuperable y presentándose como héroes por luchar valientemente contra sus crueles destinos. Los mephits son criaturas pequeñas y débiles que sirven a sus caprichos.de otras entidades elementales. Los mephits presentados aquí son menos comunes que los mephits de aire, los mephits de tierra y similares, ya que son una combinación de dos elementos diferentes en lugar de centrarse en uno solo.

feat->Composition Spells.name: Conjuros de composición
feat->Composition Spells.description:
Composition Spells

Puedes infuse tu performances with magic to create unique effects called compositions. Compositions are a special type of conjuro that often require tu to use the PERFORMANCE skill when casting them. Composition conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tu start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutos using the Refocus activity to perform, write a new composition, or otherwise engage tu muse.

Focus conjuros are automáticamente heightened to half tu nivel asaltoed up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros no require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Taking feats can give tu more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.

Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WILXkjU5Yq3yw10r]{Counter PERFORMANCE} composition conjuro, protecting against auditory and visual effects.

Composition Cantrips

Composition cantrips are special composition conjuros that no cost Focus Points, so puedes use them as often as tu like. Composition cantrips are in addition to the cantrips tu elige from the occult list. Genereunido, only feats can give tu more composition cantrips. Unlike other cantrips, puedes't swap out composition cantrips gained from bard feats at a later level, unless tu swap out the specific feat via retraining. Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, which boosts tu aliados' attacks, daño, and defense against fear.

feat->Occult Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros ocultistas
feat->Occult Spellcasting.description:
Extraes upon magic from esoteric knowledge. Puedes cast occult conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a bard, puedes normalmente play an instrument for conjuros requiring somatic or material components, as long as sufre at least one of tu hands to do so. If tu use an instrument, tu no need a material component pouch or another hand free. Puedes normalmente also play an instrument for conjuros requiring verbal components, instead of speaking.

Each día, puedes cast up to two 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tu learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each día is called tu conjuro slots.

As tu increase in level as a bard, tu number of conjuros per día increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tu to intentar una tirada de ataque de conjuro to see how effective they are, or have tu enemigos roll against tu conjuro DC (normalmente by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Charisma, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Charisma modifier.

feat->Spell Repertoire (Bard).name: Repertorio de conjuros (bardo)
feat->Spell Repertoire (Bard).description:
The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tu learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and five cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult conjuro list, or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tu increase in level. Each time obtienes a conjuro slot, tu add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tu select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tu select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tu add conjuros, tu might elige a higher-rank version of a conjuro tu already have so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tu another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tu might want to replace some of the conjuros tu previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

feat->Signature Spells.name: Conjuros de signatura
feat->Signature Spells.description:
Experience enables tu to cast some conjuros more flexibly.

For each conjuro rank tienes access to, elige one conjuro of that rank to be a signature conjuro. Tú no need to learn heightened versions of signature conjuros separately; instead, puedes heighten these conjuros freely. If has learned a signature conjuro at a higher level than sus minimum, puedes also cast all sus lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If tu swap out a signature conjuro, puedes replace it with any conjuro tu could have chosen when tu first selected it (i.e., of the same conjuro rank or lower).

Puedes also retrain specificaliado to change a signature conjuro to a different conjuro of that rank without swapping any conjuros; this takes as much time as retraining a conjuro normalmente does.

Lizardfolk Warrior.name: Lizardfolk Warrior
Lizardfolk Warrior.publicNotes:
Cuando human scholars speak de antiguo civilizations, ellos normalmente turno su focus a themselves, researching y lecturing en el first human empires. Cuando ellos drift a others, ellos invariably look a cultures que had conflicts o alliances con antiguo humanity. That el culture de el people called lizardfolk often gets ignored o forgotten even by well-meaning researchers es thus no surprise, but a el lizardfolk themselves ello es no matter. They know su history y value su integrity y privacy-si younger ancestries like humanity aren't interested en learning de lizardfolk empires dating back a before el first human derribado two rocks together a make su first campfire, que's fine con them.

El word 'lizardfolk' es un excellent example de humanity's narrow-sighted view de este culture. El name de su people es 'iruxi', but these reptilian humanoides tienen patiently y good-naturedly accepted el name 'lizardfolk' as un variant, y ellos genereunido resist urges a call humans y otro mammalians similarly derivative names en return. Iruxis dwell y thrive en todos tropical y temperate biomes, but ellos son most at home en swamplands, coastal regions, y riverlands, for ellos son talented swimmers, y fish y aquatic plantas make up un grande part de su preferred diets.

action->Sudden Charge.name: Carga repentina
action->Sudden Charge.description: With a quick sprint, the lizardfolk warrior dashes up to their enemigo and swings. They Zancada or Swim twice. If they end su movimiento al alcance cuerpo a cuerpo de at least one enemigo, they puede hacer a Golpe cuerpo a cuerpo against that enemigo.

action->Terrain Advantage.description: Non-lizardfolk criaturas in terreno difícil and non-lizardfolk criaturas that are in water and lack a swim Velocidad quedan @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to the lizardfolk scout.

Mandragora Swarm.name: Mandragora Swarm
Mandragora Swarm.publicNotes:
A mandragora looks like a freshly pulled tuber que tiene grown into the malformed shape of a child with a grotesque face and hideously bloated body. Estos insidious little plants normalmente form when a mandrake root is watered with a demon's blood. Upon absorbing the otherworldly properties of the demon's blood, the root animates and is forced to seek out blood to feast from, lest it die of thirst.

Always famished and in search for sustenance, mandragoras live haunted, pained lives and perform vile and desperate acts to acquire the blood they crave. While they prefer magicaliado infused blood such as that of unicorns, fey, or sorcerers, and pueden also feed off of potions, alchemical bombs, and other magical elixirs, a mandragora can subsist on the blood of non-magical criaturas. They find the flavor of mundane blood to be bland and bitter, and they do not blanch at voicing these complaints to la criaturas from which they drink.

While the typical mandragora is the size of a human child, some of these evil plants continue to grow and grow, reaching sizes more comparable to those of giants. Sometimes as they grow, they form additional limbs or rudimentary faces, eventualiado transforming into truly hideous mockeries of the human form.

Mastiff Of Tindalos.name: Mastiff Of Tindalos
Mastiff Of Tindalos.publicNotes:
Delgados y sedientos, los perros de Tindalos se sienten atraídos por aquellos que alteran el flujo del tiempo, viajan a través del tiempo o usan magia o drogas alquímicas raras para enviar sus pensamientos o percepciones hacia atrás o hacia adelante en el tiempo. Los lanzadores de conjuros poderosos pueden extraerlos de la Dimensión del Tiempo a través de rituales raros, pero hacerlo atrae la ira de los perros, por lo que pocos de los que trafican con tales rituales viven lo suficiente para difundir sus conocimientos. Si bien los perros poseen un intelecto muy astuto y cruel, rara vezinteractuar con otras criaturas, además de cazar y destruir a aquellos que han atraído su atención sin pestañear.

Una vez que un perro detecta el olor de un mortal para cazar, llama a otros de su calaña. Luego, la manada persigue a su víctima por todo el espacio y el tiempo hasta atraparla, matarla y devorarla. Los perseguidos solo pueden escapar evitando todos los ángulos, ya que los perros de Tindalos podrían atravesarlos desde la nada en cualquier momento.

Minognos-Ushad.name: Minognos-Ushad
Minognos-Ushad.publicNotes:
A wyvern is a venomous drake with a well-earned reputation for impatience and aggression. As much as 15 pies long and weighing up to 1,000 pounds, a wyvern's resilient body allows it to crash talons-first into large prey without serious risk to itself. A wyvern uses sus momentum to stun sus objetivo before injecting it with searing venom or carrying it over the side of a nearby cliff. Because a wyvern lacks the strength to haul sus prey all the way to sus nest intact, it is far more likely to lift and drop sus victim over a gully or canyon and let gravity do sus work before it descends to pick apart the carcass.

Conversation is of little interest to a wyvern, as la criatura normalmente speaks only to taunt sus prey, issue territorial claims, or demand tribute. Even so, many wyverns enjoy grim humor and tales of violent acts, particularly if those acts were committed by the storyteller. A wyvern properly appeased with meat, entertainment, and treasure sometimes agrees to provide assistance ranging from giving directions to serving as a mount for a powerful humanoid. However, these arrangements rarely last more than a few semanas before el guiverno's pride, malice, or insolence inspires it to flee or even betray sus aliados. Only the truly cruel can cow a wyvern into servitude for an extended period, as most wyverns are so self-interested that they go out of their way to avoid helping others.

Ravenous, bestial, and driven by instinct-drakes are primitive draconic monsters who bear a fraction of the terrifying might of their larger cousins but little (if any) of the cunning. While they're weaker, slower, and less inclined toward reason than dragons, drakes are nonetheless a menace to criaturas and settlements around them. Their propensity for forming raiding parties-small social groups fittingly called "rampages"-makes them all the more dangerous; a single rampage of river drakes can quickly lay waste to a waterside village, and roving rampages of desert drakes are a plague to caravan traders.

Drakes share a number of physical characteristics that unite them as one species despite their wide variety of habitats and abilities. For example, drakes lack forearms, leaving them only their formidable jaws and thick-scaled tails with which to attack if engaged at melee range. Most drakes would rather avoid close combat, however, preferring to use their breath armas to wreak havoc in wide swaths from comfortable distances while flying overhead. Finalmente, all drakes have small reservoirs of their ancestral draconic power that pueden tap into to perform incredible feats of speed.

In most cases, un raven swarm like el one presented here won't ataque larger enemigos, but cuando manipulated by supernatural forces o simple desperation born de hunger, un unkindness de ravens puede be un surprisingly dangerous enemigo.

Few birds son as cunning y social as el raven.

Ngara.name: Ngara
Ngara.publicNotes:
En la cultura naga, los espíritus naga descuidados y de mal genio ocupan un lugar despreciable similar al de las brujas en las culturas humanoides. Estas decrépitas criaturas viven vidas de soledad, buscadas solo por aquellos que son lo suficientemente tontos o valientes como para pensar que pueden beneficiarse de los poderes de los espíritus naga sin pagar un alto precio; para la mayoría de los que se atreven a mostrar tal arrogancia, el precio es su propio vidas.

Los espíritus nagas buscan ruinas desoladas y lugares asociados durante mucho tiempo conMuerte y corrupción. Estos siniestros seres serpentinos se pueden encontrar en cementerios abandonados, fortalezas derrumbadas, pantanos podridos y bosques arruinados. Aunque pueden saber poco de la historia real de tales lugares, los nagas se sienten atraídos por los restos psíquicos de malas acciones y espíritus atormentados que permanecen dentro de la tierra y las piedras allí.

A pesar de su horrible apariencia y el trato como parias por parte de otros nagas, los espíritus nagas sienten un profundo orgullo.en sus capacidades e incluso en sus existencias herméticas. Se ven a sí mismos conectados a una fuerza mayor cuyos misterios se revelan solo a aquellos que pueden deshacerse de las trampas y la moral de la sociedad "civilizada". Aun así, los espíritus nagas aceptan alegremente la adoración de otras criaturas dispuestas a ceder ante sus caprichos caprichosos. A menudo forman cultos a su alrededor, utilizando sus conjuros y rituales de encanto para atrapar las mentes de unos pocos individuos clave que difunden la asquerosa influencia de los nagas.en toda una comunidad.

Los nagas son identificables por sus cuerpos serpentinos y sus extrañas cabezas parecidas a las humanas. Todos los nagas tienen habilidades mágicas y una gran inteligencia, que combinan para promover sus propios objetivos.

Nightmare Rook.hpDetails: regeneration 20 (desactivada por cold iron or lawful)
Nightmare Rook.publicNotes:
Legendarily massive raptors capable of carrying off elephants as prey, rocs are normalmente about 30 pies long from beak to tail and have a wingspan of 80 pies or more. While their beaks are hooked to rip flesh from bone, their hunting strategy involves grabbing su presa in their powerful talons and then dropping it from great heights before feeding. Este method creates a massive amount of carrion, which guarantees that rocs are followed by flocks of opportunistic scavengers, such as ravens and buzzards, who find it easy to steal bits of the larger birds' meals. Rocs, for the most part, no mind these criaturas, which sometimes get gobbled up along with the rest of the roc's food.

Rocs normalmente nest among mountaintops and cliffs inaccessible to all but the bravest of terrestrial dwellers. They are long-range predators that hunt both land and sea in search for massive prey to sustain them and their young. Rocs are antisocial and lone hunters who compete with each other in fierce aerial battles to protect territory. But about once a decade, a mating couple pairs up to raise their chicks. Once the chicks are old enough to hunt on their own, the parents separate to once again engage in lone hunting.

Particularly skilled druids or rangers might capture and train a roc to serve as a flying mount or hunting companion, though examples of such an incredible feat of domestication are few and far between. The easiest way to rear a roc is to do so from the moment it hatches, since the chick imprints on the first criatura it sees. Acquiring a roc egg is by no means an easy feat, though, and is often a death sentence for the would-be egg-snatcher.

Crear un gólem de adamantina requiere una cantidad tan enorme de adamantina que reunirla suele exigir organizar una expedición minera o saquear un tesoro de escala legendaria.
