dañado por ácido ( [[/r {9d10}]]{9d10 daño} , [[/r {2d10}]]{2d10 daño} de áreas o daño persistente); curado por fuego (área [[/r 2d10[healing]]] Puntos de Golpe); ralentizado por la electricidad

Un golem es inmune a conjuros y habilidades mágicas distintas a las suyas, pero cada tipo de golem se ve afectado por algunos tipos de magia de maneras especiales. Estas excepciones se enumeran en forma abreviada.formulario en el bloque de estadísticas del golem, y las reglas completas aparecen aquí. Si una entrada enumera varios tipos (como "frío y agua"), cualquiera de los tipos de conjuro puede afectar al golem.

  • Dañado por Cualquier magia de este tipo que apunte al golem hace que reciba la cantidad de daño indicada (este daño no tiene ningún tipo) en lugar del efecto habitual. Si el golem comienza su turnoo en un área de magia de este tipo o es afectado por un efecto persistente deel tipo apropiado, toma el daño enumerado entre paréntesis.
  • Curado por Cualquier magia de este tipo que apunte al golem hace que el golem pierda la condición de ralentización y gane HP equivalente a la mitad del daño que el conjuro habría causado. Si el golem comienza su turnoo en un área de este tipo de magia, gana los HP que figuran entre paréntesis.
  • Ralentizado por Cualquier magia de este tipo que tenga como objetivoel golem hace que sea @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} para [[/br 2d6 #asaltos]]{2d6 asaltos} en lugar del efecto habitual. Si el golem comienza su turnoo en un área de este tipo de magia, se ralentiza 1 durante esa ronda.
  • Vulnerable a Cada golem es vulnerable a uno o más conjuros específicos, con los efectos descritos en su bloque de estadísticas.

action->Numerian Construct.name: Numerian Construct
action->Numerian Construct.description:
Any encounters with adamantine golems, guthallaths, or radiant wardens in Numeria are with ancient robotic versions of these criaturas. In encounters with them, describe them as having more technological aspects. The guthallath's erosion aura could be caused by clouds of deconstructor nanites and sus annihilation beams manifest as plasma blasts. The adamantine golem might have tank treads instead of legs and sus vent ability might manifest as a spray of dozens of laser beams in a cone. And the radiant warden's radiant beams and blast serve as rippling attacks of focused graviton beams.

All of these constructs have weakness 15 to critical hits and electricity, but their other statistics do not change. If tu'd rather not introduce Numeria's themes of super-science and strange technology, puedes either present these constructs as standard versions, or re-roll tu encounter to get a more appropriate result for tu game.

action->Repair Mode.name: Repair Mode
action->Repair Mode.description:
Cuando el golem Adamantita tiene 0 HP, no se destruye. En cambio, ingresa al modo de reparación, durante el cual es @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} , no puede realizar reacciones y solo puede realizar la acción de autorreparación.

Una vez que tiene más de 30 HP, puede usar cualquier tipo de acción y puede usar reacciones, aunque permanece ralentizado 1 y no puede tomar ninguna reacción hasta el inicio de su siguiente turnoo.

Si un golpe crítico con un Adamantita @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.6xaxxKfvXED6LfIY]{Vorpal} el arma reduce el golem a 0 HP, o si dicho arma lo golpea mientras ya está en 0 HP, entonces el golem es destruido.

action->Vulnerable to Dispelling.name: Vulnerable to Dispelling
action->Vulnerable to Dispelling.description:
El golem puede ser objetivo de @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ihbRf964JDXztcy3]{Disjunction} y ​​@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}.

Si es objetivo de un conjuro de nivel 9 o superior, el golem tiene su resistencia al daño físico reducida a 15 y es @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} (o @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 2} si está en modo de reparación) durante [[/br 1d4 #asaltos]]{1d4 asaltos}. Durante este tiempo, si el golem se reduce a 0 HP mientras ya está en modo de reparación, se destruye.

action->Destructive Strike.description: En un golpe crítico, el puño del golem Adamantita rompe la armadura del objetivo, si la hubiera, además de causar daño al objetivo. Si el objetivo tiene un escudo levantado, el golem rompe el escudo.

Numerian Radiant Warden.name: Numerian Radiant Warden
Numerian Radiant Warden.publicNotes:
The enigmatic and strange radiant wardens were constructed thousands of years ago to protect observatories and scholars against the incursion of alien aggressors from the Dominion of the Black. Over time, their roles as guardians expanded to include watching over any region where the laws of time and space have worn thin, particularly near portals and permanent gates between planets, planes, or dimensions.

Named for both the radial naturaleza of the concentric rings that make up their bodies as well as the glowing radiance of their attacks, radiant wardens carry on their orders, defending sites from invasion with single-minded purpose.

Nyrissa.publicNotes:
Nyrissa tiene no always been un power en el First World, but cuando ella fell en love con Count Ranalc, one de el realm's Eldest, ella challenged su place en el plane's hierarchy. El lovers inspired cada otro a increasing acts de audacity, y ello wasn't long before Nyrissa began a think de herself as el newest de el Eldest y proclaimed este a cualquier who would listen, beginning a build su own nation en el First World. Another de el Eldest, el Rey Linterna, saw opportunity for mayhem here. He spread su influence among su fellow demigods, y before long, several among el Eldest opposed Nyrissa's claim y took da pasos a challenge su. First, ellos sent un jabberwock a destruir su, but Nyrissa defeated ello y used su sangre a create menor jabberwocks under su own control. Then ellos attempted a reunido un thousand powerful fey against su, but Nyrissa convinced those fey a serve su instead en return for un place en su domain. Finalmente, el Eldest exiled Count Ranalc a el Shadow Plane for helping a cause el problem en el first place. Suddenly, Nyrissa found herself sin un aliado among el Eldest. Having expended much de su energy y resources a defeat el jabberwock y recruit el thousand, ella knew que ella had lost el war y surrendered, apologizing for su acts.

El Rey Linterna decided que Nyrissa's apology would suffice solo for el jabberwock's death; for su otro deeds, el demanded un further punishment- Nyrissa's capacity a love. Without love, el Rey Linterna argued a el otro Eldest, Nyrissa would no be able a sway another de them a su side. However, si ella could replace el "thousand fey breaths" ella stole de el First World con un thousand stolen nations, ellos would accept su apology for su otro actions y restore su capacity a love. Faced con no real option, Nyrissa agreed. She fue allowed a keep su domain, now known as Thousandbreaths, but ello fue carved off a form su own demiplane a serve as un sort de prison. Her love fue taken de su y transformed into el sword Briar, que fue then entrusted a el Rey Linterna for safekeeping. He gifted Nyrissa con un chalice el called el Apology, un artifact capable de transforming Material Plane kingdoms ella conquered into motes de sand. Once el Apology held un thousand motes de sand, those lands would be absorbed into el First World, Nyrissa would be forgiven, y love would be restored a su.

El matter settled, el Eldest quickly moved en con su own inscrutable agendas. Yet mientras ellos eventualiado forget about what ellos'd done a Nyrissa, el nymph herself did no. She grew more y more obsessed con su loss de love-o perhaps ello fue el loss de love que caused su a grow more violent y obsessed. In su early intenta una discover el location de Briar, ella received el visions que would come a haunt su-que Briar would be returned a su, but solo as un instrument de su own death.

Now ella tiene but one kingdom left a claim: el nuevo kingdom risen en el Stolen Lands. With el War de el River Kings over y one kingdom un victor, el time es right for el final grain a be added a el Apology. That este va a destruir un significant region en Golarion es irrelevant a el loveless nymph; en su obsession, ella fails a see que este act puede be el very thing que drives su enemigos de a slay su as en el vision.

Nyrissa's Tempest.name: Nyrissa's Tempest
Nyrissa's Tempest.description: Sudden dark clouds gather en el sky above, y moments later, blasts de lightning y swirling tornadoes begin a rip el landscape apart.
Nyrissa's Tempest.disable: @Check[nature|dc:42] (maestro) to note the magical naturaleza of the storm and to perform a quick ritual and prayer to the fey spirits of the region to cause the tempest to disperse, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank, counteract DC 36) to counteract the tempest immediately.
Nyrissa's Tempest.routine:
(4 actions) Si el PCs successfully sought shelter with a Supervivencia prueba, the storm takes no actions if the GM fails a @Check[flat|dc:16]. Otherwise, the storm takes four of the following actions, each determined by rolling a [[/br 1d4]], during the asalto. On each successive asalto, the number of actions the storm takes is reduced by 1; when the storm is reduced to 0 actions in this way, the hazard ends.

  • 1 Thunderclap A blast of sound rips through the region. Unsheltered armies debe intentar una DC 30 prueba de Moral or increase their shaken value by 1. Unsheltered PCs take @Damage[10d6[sonic]] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:38|basic]).
  • 2 Lightning The tempest takes sus Raging Storm reaction as a single action.
  • 3 Tornado A tornado funnel extends down from the storm to unerringly strike at a PC, who debe intentar una @Check[fortitude|dc:38] salvación.

Éxito crítico The PC escapes unscathed.

Éxito The PC queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado} and takes @Damage[8d6[bludgeoning]] daño.

Fallo The PC is hurled through the air, taking @Damage[8d6[bludgeoning]] daño y then falling 1d6×10 pies for appropriate falling daño, landing prone.

Fallo crítico Como un fallo, but @Damage[8d6[bludgeoning]] daño y a fall of [[/r 10*(2d8) #Feet Fallen]]{2d8 x 10 pies}.

  • 4 Renewal Blasts of wind tear through the área but do no real daño. Attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]; con un éxito, the number of actions the storm takes el siguiente asalto is not reduced as usual.

action->Raging Storm.name: Raging Storm
action->Raging Storm.description:
Desencadenante PCs fail an attempt to Disable the tempest, or 10 minutos pass without any attempt to leave the área (whichever comes first)

Efecto Bolts of lightning lance down from above. Si el PCs managed to succeed at a Supervivencia prueba to prepare for the storm, their armies are protected and only one PC (determined randomly) is objetivoed by this bolt, otherwise all PCs and armies are objetivoed by bolts. Against PCs, the bolt inflicts @Damage[10d6[electricity]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic]). Against armies, the bolt inflicts 1 punto de daño (DC 30 Mobility prueba negates). Then, whether or not the PCs managed to take shelter, roll initiative for Nyrissa's Tempest.

Overgrown Viper Vine.name: Overgrown Viper Vine
Overgrown Viper Vine.publicNotes:
A voracious, flesh-eating carnivore, the viper vine has a single enormous blossom arising from a thick, leafy tangle of snake-like vines. When the plant senses the approach of suitable prey through sus sensitive, shallowly buried root system, it rises up like an agitated snake and unfurls sus brightly colored bloom, an act that releases a cloud of mind-numbing pollen. Persistent stories claim the viper vine can lure prey into sus clutches by swaying with a hypnotic motion, but este efecto is in fact created by this invisible, odorless pollen cloud.

Since a viper vine gains nourishment by consuming criaturas rather than through ingesting moisture and soil, tiene developed rudimentary locomotion and can drag itself along the ground with sus tentacle-like roots. It even has a form of rudimentary sentience, allowing it to not only discern differences in prey and make limited tactical decisions, but also to avoid criaturas that are particularly large or dangerous-looking.

The área around viper vine hunting grounds is often strewn with the partialiado devoured remains of victims. It's not unusual to find the rotting corpses of wild animals, ill-fated adventurers, and even giants in the plant's immediate vicinity, along with a scattering of incidental treasure left behind on the corpses. A viper vine rarely returns to the carcass of una criatura it killed earlier, preferring to hunt fresh meat.

If a captivated criatura is adjacent to the viper vine, it stays still and no act. It ceases to be fascinated if su no longer in the pollen aura at el final de sus turno.

Oversized Chimera.name: Oversized Chimera
Oversized Chimera.publicNotes: The chimera is the archetypal example of an unnatural monster made up of a monstrous mix of wildly different component criaturas: in this case, a lion, a dragon, and a goat. Wild, hateful, and hungry, it tries to eat any criatura it sees, but sometimes a strong-willed maestro is able to compel a chimera to serve as a guardian or even a mount.

action->Three Headed.name: Three Headed
action->Three Headed.description: Any ability that would sever a chimera's head (such as a impacto crítico with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.6xaxxKfvXED6LfIY]{Vorpal Weapon}) severs one head at random. Losing a head no mata a chimera (as long as tiene one head left), but it does prevent it from making Golpes with the lost head or using the head's Arma de aliento.

action->Triple Opportunity.name: Triple Opportunity
action->Triple Opportunity.description: Un oversized chimera obtiene 2 reacciones adicionales cada asalto que ello puede usar solo a make ataques de Opportunity. It debe usar un diferente cabeza for cada reaction, y ello puede't usar more than one en el mismo triggering action. Si ello pierde one de su cabezas, ello also pierde one de these reacciones adicionales.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento

The chimera no puede usar Arma de aliento again durante [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Draconic Bite.name: Draconic Bite

action->Three-Headed Strike.name: Three-Headed Golpe
action->Three-Headed Strike.description: The oversized chimera makes a Golpe with sus dragon jaws, lion jaws, and goat horns, each at a -2 penalizador and eligiendo como objetivo una criatura distinta. Estos Golpes count as only one attack for the chimera's multiple penalizador de ataque, and the penalizador no aumenta until after tiene made all three attacks.

Phomandala.name: Phomandala
Phomandala.publicNotes:
Humanoides monstruosos que se asemejan a humanos con serpientes en lugar de cabello, las medusas son mejor conocidas por sus miradas petrificantes que, si se persisten en ellas, pueden transformar permanentemente a los mortales en piedra. Las medusas son adversarios astutos y manipuladores que recopilan y codician secretos, y que utilizan amenazas y astucia para explotar los miedos de las criaturas más débiles. Una medusa puede buscar objetos mágicos poderosos, usar magia de adivinación para descubrir conocimientos secretos y desbloquear poderes prohibidos, o infiltrarse en una sociedad paraengañar a políticos influyentes. Su capacidad para infiltrarse en organizaciones poderosas los convierte en líderes naturales de grupos criminales y gremios de ladrones, y su interés en los fenómenos mágicos lleva a algunos a seguir carreras como oráculos que se ofrecen a ayudar a los aventureros a encontrar lo que buscan, por un precio. Por supuesto, si el ingenio y el engaño resultan insuficientes, una medusa siempre puede convertir a sus rivales en adornos de piedra ornamentados con poco más que un resplandor.

ExcepcionalmenteÁgil y sorprendentemente resistente, una medusa rara vez retrocede ante un conflicto, incluso cuando está acorralada. Muchos aventureros que se creían preparados para resistir los efectos de la mirada de una medusa, sin embargo, han caído ante una medusa, ya que estas criaturas también suelen ser arqueros mortales capaces de acribillar a sus enemigos con flechas cubiertas de veneno desde la distancia. Aún así, una medusa puede negociar por su vida si no quedan alternativas, y los secretos que guardan estos poderosos villanos a menudo hacen que valga la pena salvar la vida.la vida del monstruo.

Prank Workshop Mitflit.name: Prank Workshop Mitflit
Prank Workshop Mitflit.publicNotes:
Mitflits, also known as mites, are self-loathing and pitiful cowards, easily bullied into servitude by other criaturas or even slightly more powerful mitflit leaders. They tame insects, spiders, and other such criaturas to serve as faithful aliados. Mitflits have lost most of their ancestral gremlin magic, leaving these incomplete beings full of doubt and insecurity. Mitflits find companionship in the other base criaturas of the world, and forge bonds of friendship with vermin, the only other beings that seem willing to accept them. A social structure, even one in which they are bullied, partialiado fills the hole within mitflits' personalities, and they rarely rebel or rail out unless their rage hits a breaking point.

Gremlins are cruel fey tricksters and saboteurs who have fully acclimated to life on the Material Plane, finding distinct niches for their inventive destructiveness. All gremlins delight in ruining or breaking things, whether su something physical like a device or vehicle or something intangible such as an alliance or relationship. A gremlin's greatest joy is watching the collapse of complex creations, preferably after the lightest and slightest, carefully objetivoed push from the gremlin. Gremlins tend to denigrate, bully, or even slaughter their lesser kin, particularly mitflits, whom gremlins (and many others) derisively call "mites."

Rezatha.name: Rezatha
Rezatha.publicNotes:
Un remorhaz es un enorme depredador ártico que se asemeja a un insecto de múltiples patas con rasgos dracónicos. Este monstruo tiene placas quitinosas y más de una veintena de patas segmentadas, unas fauces multipartidas y crecimientos en forma de alas que rodean su cabeza. El aspecto más inusual de la criatura, sin embargo, es su calor interno, que arde con tal intensidad que hace que las placas blindadas en la espalda de la criatura se sobrecalienten cada vez que la bestia está agitada.

Remorhazesson carnívoros. Su dieta incluye animales árticos como los alces, pero un remorhaz hambriento devora fácilmente cualquier cosa que pueda atrapar y matar. Por lo general, acecha bajo el hielo o la nieve y tiende una emboscada a su presa con un repentino golpe hacia arriba. Muchas víctimas mueren incluso antes de saber qué las atacó.

Aquellos que sobrevivan al ataque inicial del gusano deben enfrentar no solo sus mortíferas mandíbulas, sino también su horrible cuerpo caliente. Este calor puede derretir armas, quemar armaduras y quemar carne: todas las tácticas del remorhazutiliza para desactivar y derrotar a sus enemigos. El fuego interno de un remorhaz le permite atravesar el hielo y la nieve con facilidad. Deja túneles suaves a su paso a medida que el hielo derretido se vuelve a congelar para dejar señales reveladoras de su paso. La mayoría de la gente subestima la inteligencia de un remorhaz, asumiendo que es un simple animal. Sin embargo, los remorhazes son capaces de aprender idiomas. Los gigantes de hielo en particular utilizan este rasgo para formar alianzas con ellos. Los gigantes proporcionan alimento, protección y refugio al gusano, ya cambio, el remorhaz actúa como bestia guardiana y ayuda a los gigantes a construir fortalezas y forjar armas de metal. Los gigantes también emplean a los gusanos como bestias de guerra, usándolos para socavar las posiciones enemigas.

Risen Fetch.name: Risen Fetch
Risen Fetch.publicNotes:
Echoes of the corrupted soul of the undead can be used to spawn a fetch as well. A risen fetch appears more as sus source did in life than as an undead.

A fetch is a twisted, deviant simulacrum of a humanoid criatura that exists or existed at one point on the Material Plane. Rumors of fetches that are reflections of entities from other planes persist, but none of these tales speak of fetches that duplicate anything other than a sapient source. A fetch can manifest spontaneously when a powerful criatura undergoes a significant emotional event or dies, either while on the First World or while in an área significantly influenced by the First World, but one can also be created by significant forces like the Eldest in order to torment and vex those who have annoyed them. While a fetch manifests from a soul's "reflection," and as such bears a striking resemblance to esa criatura's appearance in life, a fetch has no true memories of sus own. It keeps fragments of false remembrances from sus source as if it experienced them in a half-remembered dream-which ensure the fetch is enraged by and jealous of sus source.

A fetch is similar in appearance to la criatura whose soul spawned it, salvación that it often displays fey-like features such as pointed ears, plantlike elements, or supernatural grace. A fetch who seeks to impersonate a stillliving source must disguise these features, and takes care to manifest sus fetch arma as one known to be wielded by sus objetivo.

When a fetch dies, it and sus manifested items fades away into a bloom of plant life, sus soul instantly recycled into the First World, leaving behind a patch of weeds and thorny flowers roughly in the shape they held in mockery while alive.

River Elasmosaurus.name: River Elasmosaurus
River Elasmosaurus.publicNotes:
Elasmosauruses are long-necked, primeval reptiles that dwell in deep oceans and seas. Although not truly a dinosaur, elasmosauruses are often found in similar locations and are similarly titanic criaturas. Keeping their massive bodies underwater, elasmosauruses use their long necks to catch prey and snorkel air to their massive lungs while remaining mostly oculto from the surface above. An elasmosaurus is 30 pies long and weighs 6,000 pounds.

As rare and reclusive as they are, elasmosauruses are sometimes mistaken for even rarer criaturas called water orms, legendario aquatic denizens of remote lakes known for their elusiveness and craftiness. Whereas elasmosauruses are mundane criaturas of animalistic inteligencia, water orms are magical beings with near-humanoid inteligencia and a curious fascination with mortals, and they seem to delight in confounding onlookers. As a result, su theorized that a typical water orm is more than happy to lead a group of spectators to a lost elasmosaurus, both to throw sus pursuers off sus tail and for the hilarity that will inevitably ensue.

While elasmosauruses are often found in lost worlds and unsettled regions, those who dwell in the oceans of the world do not contain their hunting grounds to specific regions. As a result, su not unheard of for a wandering specimen to find sus way to coastal waters. Those that do often find the ports of small towns or even large cities to be wondrous banquets and are normalmente hunted down by coastal guards or adventurers. When a wayward elasmosaurus like this finds sus way into a city's sewer system or reservoirs, though, puede become the stuff of urban legends.

While submerged no deeper than 15 pies underwater, an elasmosaurus todavía puede stick sus head up to breathe. An elasmosaurus gains cover against attacks made against criaturas who are above the water's surface while it is underwater, even if sus head is above the surface.

Shambler.name: Broza Movediza
Shambler.publicNotes:
Los Shamblers son astutas plantas carnívoras que se asemejan a montones de vegetación húmeda y podrida. Incluso cuando están de pie erguidos sobre sus piernas rechonchas, los shamblers no tienen mucha anatomía identificable; son marañas de enredaderas parásitas que atacan a sus presas con sus enredaderas más largas, entrelazadas para asestar golpes poderosos. A veces llamados "montículos tambaleantes", estos depredadores de emboscada tienen una afición particular por la carne y son más conocidos por su capacidad para agacharse yesconderse a plena vista. Un shambler puede extraer nutrientes de la materia vegetal o del suelo, pero no lo hará si sospecha que pronto habrá carne cerca y, de hecho, puede permanecer al acecho durante días en anticipación de dicha comida.

Los Shamblers suelen ser criaturas solitarias. Las tormentas feroces se encuentran entre los pocos eventos que reúnen a numerosos tambaleantes. Durante tales reuniones, las plantas se reúnen alrededor de extraños pero aparentemente sagrados montículos de tierra en selvas y pantanos remotos y retozan y bailan.hacen cabriolas con entusiasmo, estirando sus zarcillos hacia el cielo para esperar, o tal vez convocar, rayos intensos. Estas extrañas plantas no solo no resultan dañadas ni siquiera por los golpes eléctricos más poderosos, sino que parecen adquirir poderes sobrenaturales gracias a tales explosiones de energía bruta. Los Shamblers consideran que ser alcanzado por un rayo es una señal de favor divino, y aquellos Shamblers frecuentemente atacados por rayos de electricidad se convierten en ancianos respetados entre los de su especie. Los ancianos tambaleantes son pocos y espaciadosy puede poseer una amplia gama de habilidades; algunos pueden lanzar conjuros primarios, otros pueden pedir empáticamente la ayuda de otros tambaleantes de la zona y otros ejercen poderes asombrosos sobre la electricidad.

Existen otros tipos de shamblers, incluidos aquellos compuestos no de materia vegetal sino de crecimiento de hongos. Estas criaturas, conocidas como "montículos de esporas", liberan nubes de esporas tóxicas de sus cuerpos cuando son golpeadas en combate. En los desiertos semiáridos, plantas parecidas a shambler llamadaslos enredos habitan entre artemisas y formaciones rocosas; Se parecen a manojos de plantas rodadoras y cactus y con sus ataques infligen laceraciones profundas y sangrientas.

Exact details as to the naturaleza of the evil infesting the shrine aren't apparent other than to alert el personaje that there's certainly something dire within the shrine's walls. La criatura need not act on these urges, but as long as they pursue either goal, they gain a +1 bonificador de estado a todas las pruebas while remaining in the shrine's área. Spirit of Stisshak.name: Spirit of Stisshak
Spirit of Stisshak.publicNotes:
Malevolent balls of colored light, will-o'-wisps haunt lonely marshes and forests where they lure unsuspecting travelers into danger. Will-o'-wisps can vary the color and illumination they shed, and delight in mimicking bobbing lanterns or distant fires to draw lost or disoriented travelers off of safe trails. They can extinguish their illumination entirely to become invisible, and they enjoy doing so once their victims are wholly lost and have realized that the bobbing light in the distance no está, in fact, leading them to safety. Even invisible, however, a will-o'-wisp rarely ventures far from sus objetivo, as it feasts upon the panic and dread felt by sus victims.

Beneath sus glow, a will-o'-wisp's body is a spongy ball approximately 1 pies in diameter and weighing less than 5 pounds. Although most will-o'-wisps are merely translucent, featureless orbs, gaining definition only in the shifting illumination they create, a few have dark mottling that makes them resemble a skull when viewed closely. Will-o'-wisps have no need for mundane nourishment, and in fact lack the ability to consume matter of any kind; they find all the sustenance they need in the terror of nearby criaturas. For this reason, they like to work alongside undead that produce terror in their victims. Will-o'-wisps are long-lived, if not effectively immortal, and tienen good memories. A cowed or defeated will-o'-wisp can be a good source of LORE and information, though acquiring such cooperation from such a sinister monster is no easy feat.

Will-o'-wisps inhabit desolate swamps and forests and are genereunido active at twilight and after dark. They are therefore reluctant to lead victims into immediately fatal areas such as deadfalls, but instead prefer hazards where their victims suffer over a long time, such as pockets of stale or poisonous air, patches of quicksand, and dens of bigger monsters. According to will-o'-wisps, different types of fear have subtle differences in flavor. The lurking dread in the pit of the stomach that gnaws at those who slowly become aware of the fact that they're lost produces a much different taste than the sudden stark terror of imminent death in the face of a towering monster. Because of this, will-o'-wisps try to vary the ways in which they induce terror in su presa, to ensure they no tire of certain flavors of fear.

Talon Peak Roc.name: Talon Peak Roc
Talon Peak Roc.publicNotes:
Legendarily massive raptors capable of carrying off elephants as prey, rocs are normalmente about 30 pies long from beak to tail and have a wingspan of 80 pies or more. While their beaks are hooked to rip flesh from bone, their hunting strategy involves grabbing su presa in their powerful talons and then dropping it from great heights before feeding. Este method creates a massive amount of carrion, which guarantees that rocs are followed by flocks of opportunistic scavengers, such as ravens and buzzards, who find it easy to steal bits of the larger birds' meals. Rocs, for the most part, no mind these criaturas, which sometimes get gobbled up along with the rest of the roc's food.

Rocs normalmente nest among mountaintops and cliffs inaccessible to all but the bravest of terrestrial dwellers. They are long-range predators that hunt both land and sea in search for massive prey to sustain them and their young. Rocs are antisocial and lone hunters who compete with each other in fierce aerial battles to protect territory. But about once a decade, a mating couple pairs up to raise their chicks. Once the chicks are old enough to hunt on their own, the parents separate to once again engage in lone hunting.

Particularly skilled druids or rangers might capture and train a roc to serve as a flying mount or hunting companion, though examples of such an incredible feat of domestication are few and far between. The easiest way to rear a roc is to do so from the moment it hatches, since the chick imprints on the first criatura it sees. Acquiring a roc egg is by no means an easy feat, though, and is often a death sentence for the would-be egg-snatcher.

Tartuccio.name: Tartuccio
Tartuccio.publicNotes:
Tartuccio likes a think de himself as having been handpicked by King Irovetti de Pitax en su mission a claim el Stolen Lands for himself, but en fact King Irovetti tiene never met Tartuccio. El gnome grew up en Pitax y, de todos que nation's rulers el'd observed, Irovetti impressed him el most con su admiration de art y style. That el king wasn't very supportive de art styles y pursuits el didn't enjoy never even registered en Tartuccio's mind, as su tastes fueron so similar.

And so Tartuccio set into motion plans a catch el king's attention, so as a quedan first su student, then su trusted advisor, y en time su replacement. He even went as far as a seek out, research, y learn un potent magico technique que allowed him a change shape, intending a usar este newfound supernatural power a adjust su appearance a be something more pleasing a el king's eye cuando el time came a petition a quedan su student. Tartuccio spent meses scouring el rumor mills for opportunities, y cuando el heard de Lady Jamandi's call for heroes a expand into el Stolen Lands, el saw su chance. Tartuccio gathered su supplies y headed east.

Once el events de Chapter 1 play out, Tartuccio es unsettled by el amount de competition el faces. He travels into el Stolen Lands where el's heard rumors de un kobold settlement que's ripe for el taking, usa su ability a change shape a assume el appearance de un unusual purple kobold, y work el Sootscales into un sort de private army el intends en using a wrest control de el PJ' nation just as ellos get started. His hopes de using el PJ' kingdom as un stepping-piedra son threatened by el untimely conflict con el mitflits de el viejo Sycamore, as detailed en Chapter 2.

Fallo The action fails, and la criatura that attempted it (but not any other criatura objetivoed by the action) teleports into themselves, suffering a sudden and agonizing pain, taking [[/r (4d10 + 40)[bludgeoning]]] daño, @Damage[4d10[mental]] daño, and becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}.

Fallo crítico Como un fallo, but affecting all criaturas that would have been affected by the attempted action, and la criatura that attempted the action instead takes @Damage[80[bludgeoning]] daño, @Damage[40[mental]] daño, and queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 4}.

The Beast.name: The Beast
The Beast.publicNotes:
Con el cuerpo de un poderoso oso pardo y los agudos sentidos de un búho, el oso búho es un peligroso depredador territorial que ataca sin miedo a cualquier criatura que se adentre en sus dominios. Aquellos que chocan con un oso búho escuchan su aterrador chillido solo unos segundos antes de que la enorme criatura se acerque a ellos, desgarrándolos con garras mortales y un poderoso pico.

Aunque su origen se pierde en el tiempo, se supone que los osos búho son el resultado de un experimento mágico parahacer un depredador más astuto. Según la leyenda, el mago tuvo demasiado éxito y acabó siendo la primera víctima de la bestia. Hoy en día, los osos búho se pueden encontrar en todo el mundo y tienen una variedad de características. Si bien la subespecie más común parece un oso pardo con las características de un gran búho cornudo, los osos búho del norte helado pueden parecerse a osos polares mezclados con búhos nivales, y en las selvas tropicales templadas pueden parecerse a osos negros con cabezas de lechuzas.

La mayoría de los osos búho viven vidas solitarias, reuniéndose solo para aparearse y criar cachorros, que nacen de huevos. El territorio de un oso búho generalmente se extiende a unas 5 millas de su guarida, con signos claros de su hábitat que aparecen a 1 milla (árboles con garras, plumas gigantes y cadáveres desmenuzados). La guarida de un oso búho rara vez contiene algo de valor, pero algunos aventureros han encontrado baratijas, monedas e incluso joyas en las enormes bolitas de huesos no digeridos que estos monstruos dejan atrás.

The Dancing Lady.name: The Dancing Lady
The Dancing Lady.publicNotes:
Los no-muertos son raros en el reino de las hadas del Primer Mundo, ya que la infusión de ese avión con el poder puro de la vida hace que los no-muertos se sientan incómodos en el mejor de los casos. Sin embargo, algunos duendes han adoptado las viles prácticas y hábitos de notorios no-muertos mientras aún estaban vivos, como se ve en los hábitos de beber sangre de los asesinos baobhan sith.

Un baobhan sith evita las confrontaciones cuando los superan en número y, aunque son territoriales, no revelan su verdadera naturaleza a grupos más grandes.Prefieren beber sangre de víctimas que les parecen atractivas y evitan por completo beber sangre de animales y bestias, ya que consideran que tales actividades son incultas.

action->Release the Inmost Worm.name: Release the Inmost Worm
action->Release the Inmost Worm.description:
The First Faithful makes fists with both hands, pressing them to their temples so that their outward pointing thumbs extend to the left and right while they cry out in painful religious rapture. The horaglass-shaped scar on their forehead bulges briefly before a bloody worm is expelled from the center of the scar. Este worm shoots through the air to objetivo two criaturas a 30 pies o menos, who must then intentar una @Check[fortitude|dc:34] salvación. The First Faithful no puede Release the Inmost Worm again durante [[/br 1d4 #asaltos]]{1d4 asaltos}.

El objetivo seems to age rapidly for a moment, takes @Damage[6d6[mental]] daño, and queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} durante 1 asalto before the pain fades and el objetivo returns to sus actual age.

The Horned Hunter.name: The Horned Hunter
The Horned Hunter.publicNotes:
To a satyr, life is a party and everyone is invited. Notorious for their hedonism, these fey believe there's no greater beauty than can be found in song, drink, indulgent meals, and carnal pleasures. Satyrs use their enchanting songs and natural charm to encourage all manner of people to follow their true desires and free themselves from SOCIETY's rules. Este normalmente involves enticing mortals to join raucous parties or engage in trysts in moonlit glades. If a potential companion rejects a satyr's advances, however, the satyr has little interest in continuing a conversation and goes off to find more amenable revelers.

The lifestyle of a satyr leaves no room for ongoing affairs or long-term friends. Once his party is over or his lust is satiated, the satyr disappears back into the forest. The offspring satyrs leave behind are satyrs themselves, and normalmente end up being taken from their cradles by other fey rather than being left in mortals' care. Satyrs are always male.

The untouched beauty of the forest is sacred and precious to a satyr. Brutish intruders who clear-cut trees or massacre animals without eating them risk drawing a satyr's ire. A satyr so provoked uses his conjuros to undermine enemigos and attempts to dispatch them either with brutal ambushes or by leading a rush of forest animals to attack.

Other fey, particularly good fey, look upon satyrs as loutish, embarrassing cousins. They're rarely hostile toward satyrs, but most find them insufferable and advise any mortals they like to steer clear of satyrs' glades.

The Knurly Witch.name: The Knurly Witch
The Knurly Witch.publicNotes:
Las brujas de Annis son brutales torturadoras y asesinas, y se deleitan con los gritos musicales y la sabrosa carne de las criaturas jóvenes y de aquellos que son puros de corazón. Las brujas de Annis son las más directas de todas, participan en combates físicos y utilizan su capacidad de cambiar de forma para cazar en lugar de infiltrarse y traicionar a los humanoides. Pero una bruja de Annis toma un espantoso trofeo de cada muerte y lo usa para sembrar discordia, enviándolo a uno de los seres queridos de su víctima de una manera que implica a otra familia.miembro en el asesinato. También conocidas como brujas de hierro, las brujas Annis tienen una carne similar al hierro pero flexible que resiste las armas blancas, y su propio toque es el mismo hierro frío que quema la carne de otras brujas. Esto les permite abrirse camino a través de la intimidación hacia el liderazgo de los aquelarres de brujas.

Brujas malévolas que acechan en los límites de la civilización, las brujas usan sus habilidades mágicas y engañosas para aprovecharse de los humanoides, manipulándolos y corrompiéndolos. Algunos dicen que las brujas surgieron de hadas quequedaron retorcidos por su egoísmo interior. Las brujas se reúnen en aquelarres para obtener mayor poder, crean objetos mágicos únicos conocidos como @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ACa9QlFqdmW4s2Th]{Hag Eyes} y ​​se sabe que reemplazan a los infantes humanoides con sus propios descendientes; estos niños son @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.bAjHCeyNcPRqOmLv]{Changelings} que tienen el potencial de convertirse ellos mismos en brujas.

The Lonely Warrior.publicNotes:
Celosos guardianes de tumbas, túmulos y sepulcros, los espectros de mojones suelen engendrar a partir de rituales nigrománticos. Para aquellos mortales que no pueden soportar la idea de separarse de sus posesiones terrenales, la existencia de no-muerto que ofrece la transformación en un túmulo de piedras puede resultar tentadora. Quizás con la misma frecuencia, la realeza o los comerciantes particularmente avariciosos y ricos buscan víctimas para transformarlas en espectros de túmulos para proteger sus preciosas riquezas para siempre.

Solo enLos casos más raros es la codicia de un mortal lo suficientemente fuerte como para transformarlo espontáneamente en un túmulo de mojones sin un ritual oscuro o la intercesión de un ser divino poderoso. En esas ocasiones, sin embargo, el espectro resultante exhibe una crueldad incomparable y probablemente posee un tesoro poco común.

Como guardianes de las posesiones materiales, los espectros de mojón están vinculados sobrenaturalmente a los armamentos que usaron durante el ritual utilizado para crearlos. Pueden difundir su nigromántica.poderes en las armas que empuñan. Un corte de la espada de un tumulario canaliza la vida de la víctima al tumulario.

The Misbegotten Troll.name: The Misbegotten Troll
The Misbegotten Troll.publicNotes:
Algunos trolls han aprendido las habilidades necesarias para sobrevivir mucho más allá de la esperanza de vida típica de los de su especie y animar a otros a seguir su ejemplo. Estos campeones desarrollan una serie de talentos que los convierten en líderes dignos y cazadores potentes, a saber, sus habilidades para aumentar voluntariamente el ritmo de su regeneración y deshacerse del ácido y el fuego que la obstaculizarían, sin mencionar un rugido bestial que puede enviar -ser depredadores huyendo. Los reyes troll poseen una gran astucia.Más allá de sus parientes más jóvenes, saben mantener cerca a sus aliados y a sus enemigos aún más cerca. Si un rey troll sospecha que uno de sus seguidores está conspirando para usurparlo, el castigo es rápido y fatal.

Brutos babeantes, crueles y prácticamente invencibles: está es la descripción típica de los aldeanos de los temibles monstruos conocidos como trolls. Pero las palabras no hacen justicia a la capacidad de destrucción de los trolls. Son tan sanguinarios como los orcos pero carecen de ladisciplina, tan macizos como gigantes pero capaces de regenerar la carne herida en un instante, y tan réprobos como ogros pero con el doble de fuerza. La única forma de comprender realmente la violencia desenfrenada de un troll es experimentarla de primera mano, un destino que pocos desearían incluso para sus peores enemigos.

Lo primero que viene a la mente cuando la mayoría piensa en los trolls es el poder de regeneración corporal de las criaturas. Esta regeneración es tan potente que la única manera de superarla esExplota la vulnerabilidad del troll al ácido y al fuego. Sin embargo, no es suficiente matar al troll con armas cáusticas o incendiarias: incluso el trozo más pequeño de carne de un troll puede regenerarse hasta convertirse en un troll de tamaño completo con el tiempo suficiente. La única forma segura de erradicar la amenaza de un troll es quemar todo el cuerpo del monstruo hasta que no quede nada.

Los trolls son cazadores solitarios, porque su maldad es anatema incluso para otros gigantes. Ocasionalmente deambulan en pequeñas bandas de dos a cuatro, perosolo cuando las presas son abundantes o una fuerza contraria particularmente fuerte ha irrumpido en sus territorios de caza. En raras ocasiones, un troll viejo y poderoso llega para liderar pequeñas tribus de trolls. Estos "reyes trolls" poseen suficiente astucia para liderar a sus hordas en devastadoras incursiones y masacres, y su presencia altera permanentemente el ecosistema circundante. Existe una amplia variedad de trolls, desde el terrible monstruo tradicionalmente asociado con el nombre hasta el troll de inundación híbrido y el scrag que habita en el agua.También existen variaciones regionales (trolls de montaña entre picos pedregosos, por ejemplo, o trolls de musgo en pantanos pantanosos), pero todos comparten los mismos poderes regenerativos característicos y la misma sed insaciable de sangre.

spell->Veil.description:

El disfraz puede ocultar las identidades de los objetivos o hacer que parezcan de otra ascendencia, pero no es lo suficientemente preciso como para hacerse pasar por individuos específicos. El conjuro no cambia la voz, el olor ni los gestos. Tú eliges el disfraz de cada objetivo; por ejemplo, puedes hacer que un objetivo parezca un enano y otro un elfo. velo de fundicióncuenta como crear un disfraz para el propósito de la acción de Suplantar. Aumentado (7º) Los objetivos pueden aparecer como cualquier criatura del mismo tamaño, incluso individuos específicos. Debes haber visto a un individuo para reproducir su apariencia. El conjuro también disfraza las voces y los olores de los objetivos; adquiere los rasgos auditivos y olfativos.

Si el bag is overloaded or broken, it ruptures and is ruined, causing the items inside to be lost forever. If su turnoed inside out, the items inside spill out unharmed, but the bag must be put right before puede be used again. A criatura viva placed inside the bag has enough air durante 10 minutos before it begins to suffocate, and puede attempt to Escapar against a DC of 13. action->Discorporate.name: Discorporate
action->Discorporate.description:
Cuando el gusano que camina se reduce a 0 HP, se descorpora y los gusanos que componen su cuerpo se dispersan en todas direcciones. Si incluso un solo gusano se escapa, el gusano que camina eventualmente se volverá a formar mediante un proceso que normalmente toma [[/br 1d10 #Re-Form]] {1d10 días} .

Si bien las circunstancias y el entorno exactos determinan cuánto tiempo tienen los enemigos del gusano que camina para despachar a los gusanos que huyen antes de que escapen, por lo general sus enemigos solo tienen unaredondo. Normalmente, esto requiere la aplicación de un efecto de área o un arma de salpicadura dentro de 1 ronda en el espacio donde colapsó el gusano que camina. Después de que se inflija cualquier cantidad de daño de área o de área a ese espacio, el personaje que inflige el daño debe intentar una prueba @Check[type:flat|dc:15]. Cada área posterior o efecto de daño por salpicadura realizado en el área reduce la CD de está prueba plana en 2, hasta un mínimo de CD 5. Si cualquiera de estas pruebas planas tiene éxito, ninguno de los gusanos escapa y el gusano que caminaes destruido permanentemente.

A discreción del DJ, medios inteligentes para atrapar o detener a las alimañas pueden extender el tiempo permitido para acabar con el gusano que camina.

Thylacine.name: Thylacine
Thylacine.publicNotes:
A thylacine can be easily mistaken for a dog or jackal, but the defining stripes on their gold-hued backs and inusualmente wide gaping jaws negate this perception in close encounters. A thylacine is quite vocal, and uses a combination of growls, hisses, and gaping threat-yawns when threatened. An adult thylacine stands 2 pies tall at the shoulder, is 4 pies long (not counting an additional 2 pies of tail) and weighs roughly 50 pounds.

The thylacine is a marsupial carnivore. Este nocturnal predator normalmente hunts alone, only ocasionalmente forming small packs. Because of their odd appearance, thylacines have a far harsher reputation than they probably should, playing a sort of bogeyman role in farming communities.

It gains a +2 bonificador por circunstancia a this prueba de Intimidación, and the attempt is not penalized if el objetivo no puede understand the thylacine.

Tiger Lord Hill Giant (TL2).publicNotes:
Egoístas y toscos, estos asaltantes de piel áspera son matones y, en última instancia, cobardes. De mal genio y amante de la violencia, un gigante de las colinas ataca y saquea con gusto a los indefensos, pero huye rápidamente de aquellos que son más grandes, más fuertes o mejor organizados que ellos. Un gigante de las colinas nunca deja de empujar o engañar a uno de su especie para ralentizar a su oponente o conseguir el mejor botín.

Los gigantes son enormes criaturas humanoides que viven en lugares remotos.regiones de todo el mundo. Se dividen en varios subtipos.

Esto cuenta como dos ataques para la penalizador de ataques múltiples del gigante de la colina.

An army que está mired as a result of hurled nets can attempt to reduce the value of this mired condition (but not that caused by other sources) by attempting a Battle action against the Tok-Nikrat Scout's CD de Maniobra. Con un éxito, el ejército reduces their mired condition by 1 (or by 2 con un éxito crítico), but con un fallo critico, they increase the mired condition caused by the hurled nets by 1. Deity (Sarenrae)
feat->Deity (Sarenrae).description:
As a cleric, estás a mortal servitor of a deity tu revere above all others. Information on deities can be found in the deities compendium, along with their alignments, areas of concern, and the benefits obtienes for being a clérigo de that deity. Tu alignment must be one allowed by tu deity, as listed in their entry. Tu deity grants tu the rango de competencia entrenado in one skill and with the deity's favored arma. Si el favored arma is uncommon, tu also get access to that arma.

Tu deity also adds conjuros to tu conjuro list. Puedes prepare these just like puedes any conjuro on the divine conjuro list, once puedes prepare conjuros of their level as a cleric. Some of these conjuros aren't normalmente on the divine list, but they're divine conjuros if tu prepare them this way.

feat->Doctrine.name: Doctrina
feat->Doctrine.description:
Even among followers of the same deity, there are numerous doctrines and beliefs, which sometimes vary wildly between clerics. At 1st level, tu select a doctrine and gain the benefits of sus first doctrine. Each doctrine grants tu initial benefits at 1st level. At 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th levels, obtienes the benefits granted by tu doctrine's second, third, fourth, fifth, and final doctrines respectively.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZZzLMOUAtBVgV1DF]{Cloistered cleric}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.0Aocw3igLwna9cjp]{Warpriest}

feat->Anathema (Cleric).name: Anatema (clérigo)
feat->Anathema (Cleric).description:
Acts fundamentalmente opposed to tu deity's alignment or ideals are anathema to tu faith. Learning or casting conjuros, committing acts, and using items that are anathema to tu deity remove tu from tu deity's good graces.

Casting conjuros with the evil rasgo is almost always anathema to good deities, and casting good conjuros is likewise anathema to evil deities; similarly, casting chaotic conjuros is anathema to lawful deities, and casting lawful conjuros is anathema to chaotic deities. A neutral cleric who worships a neutral deity no está limited this way, but their alignment might change over time if they frequently cast conjuros or use abilities with a certain alignment. Similarly, casting conjuros that are anathema to the tenets or goals of tu faith could interfere with tu connection to tu deity. For example, casting a conjuro to create undead would be anathema to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma}, the goddess of death. For borderline cases, tu and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If realizas enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, or if tu alignment changes to one not allowed by tu deity, tu lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tu lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu divine font and all divine lanzamiento de conjuros. Estos abilities can be regained only if tu demonstrate tu repentance by conducting an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.

feat->Divine Font.name: Fuente Divina
feat->Divine Font.description:
Through tu deity's blessing, obtienes additional conjuros that channel either the life force called vitality energy or sus counterforce, void energy. When tu prepare tu conjuros each día, puedes prepare additional @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} conjuros, depending on tu deity. Once tu elige, puedes't change tu choice short of an ethical shift or divine intervention.

Healing Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each día at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only heal conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

Harmful Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each día at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only harm conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

feat->Divine Spellcasting (Cleric).name:
La etiqueta <Compendium> se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.AvNbdGSOTWNRgcxs]
Divine Spellcasting (clérigo)
feat->Divine Spellcasting (Cleric).description:
Tu deity bestows on tu the power to cast divine conjuros. Puedes cast divine conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a cleric, puedes normalmente hold a divine focus (such as a religious symbol) for conjuros requiring material components instead of needing to use a conjuro component pouch.

At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the divine conjuro list in this book or from other divine conjuros to which obtienes access. Prepared conjuros remain available to tu until tu cast them or until tu prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots.

As tu increase in level as a cleric, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each día increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tu to intentar una tirada de ataque de conjuro to see how effective they are, or tu enemigos to roll against tu conjuro DC (normalmente by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Wisdom, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Wisdom modifier.

feat->First Doctrine.name: Primera Doctrina

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.aiwxBj5MjnafCMyn]{Cloistered cleric}

deity->Sarenrae.description:
La etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.BNycwu3I21dTh4D9]

Sarenrae is one of the most popular deities on Golarion by virtue of her association with the life-giving sun and her perpetual offer to help anyone be their best, even when tienen made mistakes. Most people thank her for her kind work to channel the sun's power for everyone's safety and livelihood, and thank her clergy for granting her healing power to all who need it. Mortals look to the Dawnflower as an example of boundless love, exquisite kindness, and true patience. They pray to her to heal the sick, lift up the downtrodden, and illuminate darkness of circumstance as well as darkness of spirit. Her followers aspire to emulate her through generosity, nurturing, truthfulness, and selfless courage. They oppose evil everywhere with words first, and when necessary, with scimitar and flame.

Edicts destroy the Spawn of Rovagug, protect aliados, provide aid to the sick and wounded, seek and allow redemption

Anathema create undead, lie, deny a repentant criatura an opportunity for redemption, fail to strike down evil

Areas of Concern healing, honesty, redemption, and the sun

feat->Deity (Sarenrae).description:
As a cleric, estás a mortal servitor of a deity tu revere above all others. Information on deities can be found in the deities compendium, along with their alignments, areas of concern, and the benefits obtienes for being a clérigo de that deity. Tu alignment must be one allowed by tu deity, as listed in their entry. Tu deity grants tu the rango de competencia entrenado in one skill and with the deity's favored arma. Si el favored arma is uncommon, tu also get access to that arma.

Tu deity also adds conjuros to tu conjuro list. Puedes prepare these just like puedes any conjuro on the divine conjuro list, once puedes prepare conjuros of their level as a cleric. Some of these conjuros aren't normalmente on the divine list, but they're divine conjuros if tu prepare them this way.

feat->Doctrine.name: Doctrina
feat->Doctrine.description:
Even among followers of the same deity, there are numerous doctrines and beliefs, which sometimes vary wildly between clerics. At 1st level, tu select a doctrine and gain the benefits of sus first doctrine. Each doctrine grants tu initial benefits at 1st level. At 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th levels, obtienes the benefits granted by tu doctrine's second, third, fourth, fifth, and final doctrines respectively.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZZzLMOUAtBVgV1DF]{Cloistered cleric}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.0Aocw3igLwna9cjp]{Warpriest}

feat->Anathema (Cleric).name: Anatema (clérigo)
feat->Anathema (Cleric).description:
Acts fundamentalmente opposed to tu deity's alignment or ideals are anathema to tu faith. Learning or casting conjuros, committing acts, and using items that are anathema to tu deity remove tu from tu deity's good graces.

Casting conjuros with the evil rasgo is almost always anathema to good deities, and casting good conjuros is likewise anathema to evil deities; similarly, casting chaotic conjuros is anathema to lawful deities, and casting lawful conjuros is anathema to chaotic deities. A neutral cleric who worships a neutral deity no está limited this way, but their alignment might change over time if they frequently cast conjuros or use abilities with a certain alignment. Similarly, casting conjuros that are anathema to the tenets or goals of tu faith could interfere with tu connection to tu deity. For example, casting a conjuro to create undead would be anathema to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma}, the goddess of death. For borderline cases, tu and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If realizas enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, or if tu alignment changes to one not allowed by tu deity, tu lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tu lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu divine font and all divine lanzamiento de conjuros. Estos abilities can be regained only if tu demonstrate tu repentance by conducting an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.

feat->Divine Font.name: Fuente Divina
feat->Divine Font.description:
Through tu deity's blessing, obtienes additional conjuros that channel either the life force called vitality energy or sus counterforce, void energy. When tu prepare tu conjuros each día, puedes prepare additional @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} conjuros, depending on tu deity. Once tu elige, puedes't change tu choice short of an ethical shift or divine intervention.

Healing Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each día at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only heal conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

Harmful Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each día at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only harm conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

feat->Divine Spellcasting (Cleric).description:
Tu deity bestows on tu the power to cast divine conjuros. Puedes cast divine conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a cleric, puedes normalmente hold a divine focus (such as a religious symbol) for conjuros requiring material components instead of needing to use a conjuro component pouch.

At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the divine conjuro list in this book or from other divine conjuros to which obtienes access. Prepared conjuros remain available to tu until tu cast them or until tu prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots.

As tu increase in level as a cleric, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each día increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tu to intentar una tirada de ataque de conjuro to see how effective they are, or tu enemigos to roll against tu conjuro DC (normalmente by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Wisdom, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Wisdom modifier.

Sarenrae is one of the most popular deities on Golarion by virtue of her association with the life-giving sun and her perpetual offer to help anyone be their best, even when tienen made mistakes. Most people thank her for her kind work to channel the sun's power for everyone's safety and livelihood, and thank her clergy for granting her healing power to all who need it. Mortals look to the Dawnflower as an example of boundless love, exquisite kindness, and true patience. They pray to her to heal the sick, lift up the downtrodden, and illuminate darkness of circumstance as well as darkness of spirit. Her followers aspire to emulate her through generosity, nurturing, truthfulness, and selfless courage. They oppose evil everywhere with words first, and when necessary, with scimitar and flame.

Areas of Concern healing, honesty, redemption, and the sun

Troll Guard.name: Troll Guard
Troll Guard.publicNotes:
Algunos trolls han aprendido las habilidades necesarias para sobrevivir mucho más allá de la esperanza de vida típica de los de su especie y animar a otros a seguir su ejemplo. Estos campeones desarrollan una serie de talentos que los convierten en líderes dignos y cazadores potentes, a saber, sus habilidades para aumentar voluntariamente el ritmo de su regeneración y deshacerse del ácido y el fuego que la obstaculizarían, sin mencionar un rugido bestial que puede enviar -ser depredadores huyendo. Los reyes troll poseen una gran astucia.Más allá de sus parientes más jóvenes, saben mantener cerca a sus aliados y a sus enemigos aún más cerca. Si un rey troll sospecha que uno de sus seguidores está conspirando para usurparlo, el castigo es rápido y fatal.

Brutos babeantes, crueles y prácticamente invencibles: está es la descripción típica de los aldeanos de los temibles monstruos conocidos como trolls. Pero las palabras no hacen justicia a la capacidad de destrucción de los trolls. Son tan sanguinarios como los orcos pero carecen de ladisciplina, tan macizos como gigantes pero capaces de regenerar la carne herida en un instante, y tan réprobos como ogros pero con el doble de fuerza. La única forma de comprender realmente la violencia desenfrenada de un troll es experimentarla de primera mano, un destino que pocos desearían incluso para sus peores enemigos.

Lo primero que viene a la mente cuando la mayoría piensa en los trolls es el poder de regeneración corporal de las criaturas. Esta regeneración es tan potente que la única manera de superarla esExplota la vulnerabilidad del troll al ácido y al fuego. Sin embargo, no es suficiente matar al troll con armas cáusticas o incendiarias: incluso el trozo más pequeño de carne de un troll puede regenerarse hasta convertirse en un troll de tamaño completo con el tiempo suficiente. La única forma segura de erradicar la amenaza de un troll es quemar todo el cuerpo del monstruo hasta que no quede nada.

Los trolls son cazadores solitarios, porque su maldad es anatema incluso para otros gigantes. Ocasionalmente deambulan en pequeñas bandas de dos a cuatro, perosolo cuando las presas son abundantes o una fuerza contraria particularmente fuerte ha irrumpido en sus territorios de caza. En raras ocasiones, un troll viejo y poderoso llega para liderar pequeñas tribus de trolls. Estos "reyes trolls" poseen suficiente astucia para liderar a sus hordas en devastadoras incursiones y masacres, y su presencia altera permanentemente el ecosistema circundante. Existe una amplia variedad de trolls, desde el terrible monstruo tradicionalmente asociado con el nombre hasta el troll de inundación híbrido y el scrag que habita en el agua.También existen variaciones regionales (trolls de montaña entre picos pedregosos, por ejemplo, o trolls de musgo en pantanos pantanosos), pero todos comparten los mismos poderes regenerativos característicos y la misma sed insaciable de sangre.

Desencadenante Tulvak uses Change Shape to assume her natural shape

action->Crumbling Edge.name: Crumbling Edge

Desencadenante Una criatura comes within 5 pies of the pit's edge

Efecto edge of the pit crumbles. The la criatura desencadenante debe intentar una @Check[reflex|dc:19] salvación.

Tu proficiency rank for salvación de Voluntads increases to experto. When obtienes a éxito at a salvación de Voluntad against a efecto de miedo, obtienes a éxito crítico instead. In addition, anytime obtienes the asustado condition, reduce sus value by 1.

feat->Fighter Weapon Mastery (Sword).description: Las horas pasadas entrenando con tus armas predilectas, aprendiendo y desarrollando nuevas técnicas de combate, te han hecho particularmente efectivo con las armas que prefieres. Elige un grupo de armas. Tu rango de competencia se incrementa a maestro con las armas sencillas, las armas marciales y los ataques sin arma de dicho grupo, y a experto con las armas avanzadas de dicho grupo. Obtienes acceso a los efectos de especialización crítica de todas las armas y ataques sin arma para los que tienes competencia a rango maestro.

feat->Battlefield Surveyor.name: Topógrafo del campo de batalla
feat->Battlefield Surveyor.description: Whether taking stock of an enemigo army or simply standing guard, tu excel at observing tu enemigos. Tu proficiency rank for Perception increases to maestro. In addition, obtienes a +2 bonificador por circunstancia a Perception pruebas for initiative, making tu faster to react during combat.

feat->Weapon Specialization.name: Especialización en armas
feat->Weapon Specialization.description:
champion, fighter, Gunslinger, Inventor, Investigator, Magus, monk, ranger, rogue, Swashbuckler: Has learned how to inflict greater injuries with the armas tu know best. Tú deal 2 daño adicional with armas and ataques sin armas in which estás an experto. Este daño increases to 3 if estás a maestro, and to 4 if estás legendario.

alchemist, bard, cleric, druid, Oracle, Psychic, sorcerer, Summoner, Witch, wizard Has learned how to inflict grave wounds with tu most practiced armas. Tú deal 2 daño adicional with armas and ataques sin armas in which estás an experto. Este daño increases to 3 if estás a maestro, and to 4 if estás legendario.

bárbaro: Tu rage helps tu hit harder. Tú deal an additional 2 daño with armas and ataques sin armas in which tienes experto proficiency. Este daño increases to 3 if estás a maestro, and 4 if estás legendario.

Obtienes tu instinct's specialization ability. See specific instincts for more information.

feat->Combat Flexibility.name: Flexibilidad de combate
feat->Combat Flexibility.description: Through tu experience in battle, puedes prepare tu tactics to suit different situations. When tu make tu daily preparations, obtienes one fighter feat of 8th level or lower that tu no already have. Puedes use that feat until tu next daily preparations. Debes meet all of the feat's other prerequisites.

feat->Juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
feat->Juggernaut.description:
barbarian, champion, fighter, Inventor, ranger Tu body is accustomed to physical hardship and resistant to ailments. Tu proficiency rank for salvación de Fortalezas increases to maestro. When obtienes a éxito on a salvación de Fortaleza, obtienes a éxito crítico instead.

alchemist Tu body has become accustomed to physical hazards and resistant to pathogens and ailments. Tu proficiency rank for salvación de Fortalezas increases to maestro. When obtienes a éxito on a salvación de Fortaleza, obtienes a éxito crítico instead.

Magus Tu body is accustomed to physical hardship and resistant to a wide range of ailments. Tu proficiency rank for salvación de Fortalezas increases to maestro. When obtienes a éxito on a salvación de Fortaleza, obtienes a éxito crítico instead.

Gunslinger Tu body has become accustomed to physical hazards and resistant to ailments. Tu proficiency rank for salvación de Fortalezas increases to maestro. When obtienes a éxito on a salvación de Fortaleza, obtienes a éxito crítico instead.

Vicious Army Ant Swarm.publicNotes: Un army ant swarm es un terrifying carpet de stinging insects que devours todos en su path.

action->Cling.name: Aferrarse
action->Cling.description:
Desencadenante Una criatura leaves the swarm's space

Efecto swarm takes @Damage[1d6[untyped]] daño as ants cling to la criatura and continue biting, dealing @Damage[7d6[persistent,piercing]] daño. High winds or immersion in water reduces the DC of the prueba plana to end this daño persistente to 5. Any área daño dealt to la criatura destroys these clinging ants.

action->Swarming Bites.name: Swarming Bites
action->Swarming Bites.description: Each enemigo in the swarm's space takes @Damage[7d6[piercing]] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:31|basic] salvación). Una criatura que fails sus salvación against Swarming Bites queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1} durante 1 asalto. If la criatura intenta una concentrate or manipulate action while affected, it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] prueba or the action is lost; roll the prueba after spending the action, but before any effects are applied.

Vilderavn Herald.name: Vilderavn Herald
Vilderavn Herald.publicNotes: In su true form, un vilderavn herald es un human-sized raven. Its ability a assume un humanoide guise suits ello a insinuate itself into el retinue de un mortal ruler o a travel sin too much concern, but more often these deadly fey directly serve more powerful rulers, such as el Eldest.

As @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]{Frightful Presence}, plus una criatura asustado by the aura becomes suspicious: it no count any other criatura as sus aliado, and it no puede @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} or flank. The vilderavn can activate or deactivate está aura using a single action, which has the rasgo concentración.

action->Bloodbird.name: Bloodbird
action->Bloodbird.description: Una criatura hit by a vilderavn's melee attack becomes cursed, taking @Damage[2d6[bleed]] daño that's difficult to stanch: the DC to stop the bleeding using Administer First Aid is 35, and healing la criatura to full PG no automáticamente end the bleeding. Removing the curse ends the bleeding.

action->Change Shape.description:
La etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.eQM5hQ1W3d1uen97]

The vilderavn takes on the shape of a wolf or dire wolf, a wolf-raven hybrid, or sus raven knight form: a Pequeño or Mediano humanoid in black full plate carrying a greatsword. The vilderavn puede usar sus jaws attack only in a form que tiene a wolf's head, sus talon attack only in a form que tiene raven talons, and sus greatsword only in raven knight form.

action->Souleater.name: Souleater
action->Souleater.description: Si el vilderavn kills a humanoid objetivo with a impacto crítico using sus Golpe de fauces, it rips out and devours la mente del objetivo heart and soul as part of the attack. While el objetivo is dead, the vilderavn can Change Shape into la mente del objetivo form, gaining a +4 bonificador de estado to prueba de DECEPTIONs to impersonate el objetivo. If magic would resurrect la criatura, quien lo lanza must succeed at a DC 38 counteract prueba to extract la mente del objetivo soul from the vilderavn; otherwise the conjuro fails.

weapon->Greataxe.description:
La etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.8COlYvHe6hKCXY8x]

Esta gran hacha de batalla es demasiado pesada para manejarla con una sola mano. Muchas grandes hachas incorporan dos hojas y, a menudo, tienen "barba" y tienen un gancho en la parte inferior para aumentar la fuerza de su poder de corte.

action->Deny Advantage.name: Negar ventaja
action->Deny Advantage.description:
Bárbaro A tus enemigos les cuesta superar tus defensas. No quedas desprevenido ante criaturas ocultas, indetectadas o que te flanqueen si son de tu nivel o inferior, ni ante criaturas de tu nivel o inferior que usen ataque sorpresa. Sin embargo, aún pueden ayudar a sus aliados a flanquear.

Pícaro Como alguien que aprovecha las defensas ajenas, procuras no dejar esas aberturas tú mismo. No quedas desprevenido ante criaturas ocultas, indetectadas o que te flanqueen si son de tu nivel o inferior, ni ante criaturas de tu nivel o inferior que usen ataque sorpresa. Sin embargo, aún pueden ayudar a sus aliados a flanquear.

action->Raging Resistance.name: Resistencia Furiosa
action->Raging Resistance.description: While raging, Villamor Koth gains resistance 7 to daño físico del arma (but not daño físico from other sources, such as ataques sin armas).

action->Axe Specialization.name: Axe Specialization
action->Axe Specialization.description: Villamor Koth obtiene el critical specialization effects for todos axes el wields.

action->Furious Finish.name: Remate furioso
action->Furious Finish.description: Desperate to finish the fight, Villamor Koth pours all his rage into one final blow. Hace a Golpe. Si impacta, he gains a bonificador por circunstancia a daño equal to the number of asaltos remaining in his Rage (maximum 10). After this Golpe, his Rage immediately ends and he queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigado} until he rests for at least 10 minutos.

action->Giant's Lunge.name: Zancada de gigante
action->Giant's Lunge.description: Villamor Koth extends his body and prepares to attack enemigos outside his normal reach. Until his rage ends, all his melee armas and ataques sin armas gain reach 10. Este no aumenta the reach of any arma or ataque sin armas that already has the reach rasgo, but it does combine with abilities that increase his reach due to increased size.

action->Knockback.name: Arredrar
action->Knockback.description:
Requisitos Villamor Koth's last action was a successful Golpe.

Efecto Villamor Koth pushes his enemigo back 5 pies, with el efectos of a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Empujar}. He can follow el enemigo as normal for a successful shove.

action->Rage.name: Furia

Vordakai.name: Vordakai
Vordakai.publicNotes:
At the height of his power well over 10,000 years ago, the original Vordakai was among the most powerful necromancers of the land. When this cyclops tyrant was defeated during the chaos following Earthfall, one of his apprentices claimed his name as well as his greatest treasure, the Oculus of Abaddon. Though he had been the least of the necromancer's apprentices, the new Vordakai was nevertheless a powerful wizard, but it would take more than power to claim the true Vordakai's mantle. Betrayed by followers of the original leader who refused to serve him, the new Vordakai was sealed into his own tomb, and over the passage of eons, the cyclops lich atrophied.

Although much weakened today, Vordakai remains a dangerous opponent who can devastate a poorly prepared party on his own. Don't be afraid to play Vordakai as arrogant criatura-tiene existed for longer than most criaturas on Golarion, after all, and if he makes arrogant mistakes (such as neglecting to cast conjuros defensively or provoking Attacks of Opportunity), that not only gives the PCs a chance to survive but also helps to establish the ancient lich as both overconfident and a bit careless from his long period of quiescence. Keep in mind that Vordakai is the most powerful enemigo the PCs have encountered in the Kingmaker Adventure Path thus far, and in defeating him, they will accomplish something truly legendario.

If Vordakai has the chance to prepare for battle before combat, he takes 3 asaltos to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SwUiVavHKMWG7t5K]{Truespeech}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy} (choosing an energy type he knows the PCs favor as a result of watching them via his familiar), and then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.j8vIoIEWElvpwkcI]{Mirror Image} just before entering battle. Finalmente, he activates @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} using the Oculus of Abaddon before entering combat (doing so in the first asalto of a fight if instead he's caught by surprise by the PCs).

Once combat begins, Vordakai starts by casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} on the party's strongest healer; if successful, he commands the healer to his side to defend him by attacking anyone who attacks the lich in melee. On subsequent asaltos, Vordakai uses ranged magic against the party, casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fd31tAHSSGXyOxW6]{Vampiric Exsanguination} as soon as he's reduced to 100 Puntos de Golpe or fewer. When facing only one or two enemigos, he prefers to attack with Consume Memories followed by a hand Golpe, opting to salvación his conjuros for an emergency.

The greatest diminishment of Vordakai's power is represented through the loss of his soul cage-the magical item he inicialmente used to trap his own soul and enable his transformation into a lich in the first place. He cannot create a replacement as long as he remains atrophied, but his arrogance works against him here. Only if he's reduced below 20 Puntos de Golpe does he realize that the PCs have a very good chance to defeat him, and if he survives long enough to take a turno after this realization, he casts his 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} to flee to área C5 of his tomb. If he's able to escape in this way, he'll wait for a few días before returning to his tomb, infuriated if the PCs have released his prisoners and robbed him blind. At this point, Vordakai can become a recurring villain in tu campaign!

action->Atrophied Lich.name: Atrophied Lich
action->Atrophied Lich.description:
Sometimes, a lich that remains immobile and insensible for extended periods of time-as Vordakai did after he was imprisoned in his tomb just prior to Earthfall 10,000 years ago-can become atrophied. The exact effects of atrophy vary from lich to lich but always result in a reduction of lanzamiento de conjuros power and daño a their soul cage link.

In Vordakai's case, tiene forgotten much arcane LORE and lost a significant amount of his lanzamiento de conjuros ability. At the height of his power, he was a 20th-level wizard, but today, his power has reduced to that of a 12th-level wizard. More troubling to the lich is the fact that puede no longer use a soul cage to rejuvenate-if Vordakai is destroyed, he crumbles to dust, forever dead. Given time, Vordakai could recover his power and regain his rejuvenation ability, but su unlikely the PCs will give him that chance, as it would take the lich several years to undo the ravages of centuries.
